mesh_radios.name: Persistent Systems MPU5 — Wave Relay Smart Radio
mesh_radios.description: The MPU5 is a handheld 3x3 MIMO MANET smart radio running Wave Relay OS (custom Android). Integrates data, video, voice, PTT audio, GPS, and onboard compute in a single ruggedized IP68 unit. Self-forming/self-healing peer-to-peer mesh with no master node, no hop limit, and no node limit. Interchangeable Frequency Module architecture supports L-band through upper C-band. FIPS 140-2 Level 2 validated. Blue UAS certified. Wave Relay IRD provides EW countermeasures assessed by DoD.

receivers.name: HappyModel ES900 900MHz ELRS Dual RX Diversity Receiver
receivers.description: The HappyModel ES900 900MHz ELRS Dual RX Diversity Receiver has 915MHz / 868MHz and built-in TCXO. Ideal for RC Airplanes and FPV Long Range Drones.

receivers.name: ImmersionRC Tramp/Ghost Hybrid DUO V2 2.4GHz Rx & 25-600mW 5.8GHz VTX
receivers.description: The new ImmersionRC Tramp/Ghost Hybrid DUO V2 is a high-end analog 5.8GHz 25mW - 600mW video transmitter and 2.4GHz diversity receiver!

receivers.name: TBS Crossfire Diversity Nano RX
receivers.description: A full-capability TBS Crossfire Diversity receiver in nano form factor. Ideal for long range miniquads or smaller wings.

receivers.name: RadioMaster XR1 Nano Multi-Frequency Receiver - ELRS 2.4GHz
receivers.description: The XR1 Receiver is a compact ExpressLRS receiver, measuring 20 x 13mm. Powered by the third-generation Semtech LR1121 transceiver, it operates on 2.4GHz, offering excellent range and sensitivity in a lightweight design.

receivers.name: RadioMaster XR3 Nano Multi-Frequency Diversity Receiver - ELRS 2.4GHz
receivers.description: The XR3 Receiver is a compact ExpressLRS receiver, measuring 20 x 15mm and powered by the third-generation Semtech LR1121 transceiver. It operates on 2.4GHz, offering exceptional range and sensitivity in a lightweight design, which is ideal for any build.

receivers.name: HGLRC Gemini ELRS 2.4GHz RX Dual Receiver
receivers.description: Introducing the HGLRC ELRS 2.4GHz GEMINI Receiver, a cutting-edge receiver with dual communication links and true diversity dual reception for exceptional anti-interference performance.

receivers.name: HGLRC Gemini ELRS 915MHz RX Dual Receiver
receivers.description: Introducing the HGLRC Gemini RX Dual Receiver, a cutting-edge receiver with dual communication links and true diversity dual reception for exceptional anti-interference performance.

receivers.name: Foxeer ELRS Diversity Receiver - 915MHz
receivers.description: Introducing the advanced Foxeer 915MHz RX Module, designed to deliver exceptional performance and reliability for your FPV drone needs.

receivers.name: DarwinFPV Cement Ultra Durable ELRS 2.4GHz Receiver
receivers.description: Introducing the DarwinFPV Cement Ultra Durable ELRS 2.4GHz Receiver, engineered to withstand extreme environments.

receivers.name: BETAFPV SuperD ELRS 2.4GHz Diversity Receiver

receivers.name: GEPRC Gemini Xrossband Receiver - ELRS 2.4Ghz/915Mhz
receivers.description: Unlock the full potential of long-range and reliable control with the GEPRC Gemini Xrossband Receiver - ExpressLRS 2.4GHz/915MHz. Built on Semtech’s cutting-edge LR1121 RF chip and developed from the open-source ExpressLRS project, this advanced dual-band receiver supports both sub-GHz (915MHz) and 2.4GHz bands—delivering seamless frequency switching and dual-band operation for superior link performance.

video_transmitters.description: Integrating DJI's cutting-edge video transmission technology into a lightweight and compact body, the DJI O3 Air Unit features excellent video transmission quality with high definition and low latency - even at long distances.

video_transmitters.name: DJI O3 Air Unit Transmission Module

video_transmitters.name: DJI Transmission Combo

video_transmitters.name: Immersion RC Ghost Ultimate Hybrid 5.8GHz VTX & 2.4GHz Rx

video_transmitters.name: CubePilot Herelink 2.4GHz Long Range HD Video Transmission System - V1.1
video_transmitters.description: The Herelink HD Digital Video Transmission System is an all-in-one solution for long-range HD video transmission. Brought to you by CubePilot, the team who brought you Pixhawk and The Cube GPS system.

video_transmitters.name: Happymodel ELRS Fyujon V1.0 AIO Board - 5.8GHz OPENVTX + 2.4GHz ERLS RX
video_transmitters.description: The Happymodel ELRS Fyujon is a very simple and easy-to-use 2-in-1 module that integrates 5.8GHz video transmission and a 2.4GHz ELRS receiver.

video_transmitters.name: RushFPV Rush Tank Race II 5.8GHz VTX w/ SmartAudio

video_transmitters.name: MATEKSYS VTX-1G3SE 2CH Video Transmitter - 1.2GHz/1.3GHz (U.S. Version)

video_transmitters.name: HGLRC Zeus 800mW Smart Mounting 20x20 / 30x30 VTX

video_transmitters.name: ImmersionRC Ghost Proton 20x20 Pack
video_transmitters.description: The ImmersionRC Ghost Proton 20x20 Pack is a printed circuit board (PCB) designed to dramatically simplify wiring, mounting, and cooling of Tramp Nano + Ghost combinations.

video_transmitters.name: BETAFPV A01 25-200mW 5.8GHz VTX

video_transmitters.name: Lumenier LUX Mini 20x20 5.8GHz FPV Video Transmitter (25-800mW)

video_transmitters.name: Rush Tank Ultimate Plus 5.8GHz VTX w/ Smart Audio

video_transmitters.name: FXT ARES 5.8GHz PIT/25mw/200mw/600mw/1W VTX w/ Smart Audio

esad.description: US-manufactured electronic safe-and-arm device (ESAD) for FPV strike drones and loitering munitions. esad.ndaa_note: Kraken Kinetics, Huntsville AL. US ESAD manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

esad.name: EBAD Initiators & Safe-Arm Devices
esad.description: Heritage initiator and safe-arm device manufacturer with decades of ordnance fuzing experience. Products include NSI (NASA Standard Initiator) derivatives and custom ESAD solutions for defense programs. Part of the legacy aerospace ordnance supply chain.
esad.ndaa_note: EBAD, Simsbury CT. US defense pyrotechnics. NDAA compliant.

esad.name: PacSci EMC ESAD Solutions
esad.description: Major US manufacturer of energetic devices including ESADs, detonators, and initiators for missile and munition programs. MIL-STD-1316 compliant. Supplies multiple US defense prime contractors. Part of Fortive Corporation.
esad.ndaa_note: Pacific Scientific EMC, Duarte CA. Fortive subsidiary. US ESAD/initiator manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

esad.name: Excelitas Blue Chip LEEFI
esad.description: Laser Energy Enhanced Firing Initiator (LEEFI) — uses laser light through fiber optic to fire initiator, providing inherent electrical isolation from stray RF/EMI. Blue Chip is the product family name. Represents the state of the art in electrically safe initiation for modern munitions.
esad.ndaa_note: Excelitas Technologies, Waltham MA. US defense electronics. NDAA compliant.

esad.name: Excelitas ESAD Modules
esad.description: Complete ESAD modules integrating initiator, safety logic, and arming sequences. Designed for guided munitions and loitering munition programs requiring certified safe-and-arm capability.
esad.ndaa_note: Excelitas Technologies, Waltham MA. US defense electronics. NDAA compliant.

esad.name: L3Harris Safe-Arm Systems
esad.description: Defense-grade safe-and-arm systems from L3Harris for precision guided munitions and missile programs. Full MIL-STD-1316 compliance with multiple independent safety inhibits. Heritage across numerous US weapon programs.
esad.ndaa_note: L3Harris Technologies. US defense prime. NDAA compliant.

esad.name: GATE Technologies ESAD
esad.description: Israeli ESAD manufacturer providing safe-and-arm solutions for Israeli defense UAS and munition programs. Part of Israel's indigenous precision munition supply chain.
esad.ndaa_note: GATE Technologies, USA. US ESAD manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

esad.name: XTEND ESAD Fuse Board
esad.description: Israeli-developed ESAD fuse board designed for integration into FPV and loitering munition platforms. Compact form factor for retrofit into existing drone airframes being converted to strike capability.

esad.name: EDGE ESAD-50
esad.description: UAE-manufactured ESAD from EDGE Group (Abu Dhabi defense conglomerate). Part of UAE's growing indigenous munition electronics capability. Designed for integration into UAE and export loitering munition programs.
esad.ndaa_note: EDGE Group, Abu Dhabi, UAE. UAE state defense conglomerate. UAE is a US partner but not a formal allied nation under NDAA — verify per contract.

esad.name: Chemring Energetics ESAD
esad.description: UK defense energetics company manufacturing ESADs, initiators, and ordnance electronics. Heritage in NATO munition programs. Part of UK's sovereign ordnance supply chain.
esad.ndaa_note: Chemring Group plc, Hampshire, UK. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Major UK defense pyrotechnics/countermeasures.

esad.name: Junghans Defence Fuze Systems
esad.description: German precision fuze and ESAD manufacturer — part of Diehl Defence Group. Produces electronic and mechanical fuzes for NATO munition programs. German/NATO sovereign supply chain.
esad.ndaa_note: Junghans Defence GmbH, part of Diehl Defence, Überlingen, Germany. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

esad.name: Day & Zimmermann Micro-Miniature ESAF
esad.description: Micro-miniature Electronic Safe, Arm and Fire devices for gun-launched weapons. Shock-hardened designs proven to survive and function post-launch. Includes proximity, sensor fuzed, impact, and timed self-destruct detonation. Removable detonator for full functionality testing. ISO 9001 manufacturing.
esad.ndaa_note: Day & Zimmermann, Philadelphia PA. US defense/munitions company. NDAA compliant.

lidar.name: LightWare SF000/B
lidar.notes: World's smallest and lightest 50m microLiDAR sensor. Ideal for extreme SWaP-constrained applications.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare SF11/C
lidar.range_condition: White wall in daylight, some sources cite 120m max
lidar.notes: Long-standing preferred AGL altitude sensor. Solid autopilot platform support. DigiKey lists as obsolete — check availability. Iconic LightWare product.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare SF20/C
lidar.type: Static single beam with servo driver
lidar.notes: Lightest 100m sensor in the world at 7.5g. Open-frame OEM unit. LW20/C is the IP67 sealed version of the same sensor. Onboard servo driver enables scanning LiDAR with external digital servo.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare LW20/C
lidar.type: Static single beam with servo driver
lidar.notes: IP67 sealed version of SF20/C. Industry de facto standard for 100m range. LW20/HA variant offers improved accuracy to <1cm at 20-30°C.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare LW20/HA
lidar.type: Static single beam with servo driver
lidar.notes: High-accuracy variant of LW20/C. Class-leading 1cm accuracy across full 100m range at optimal temps. Same form factor as LW20/C.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare SF23/B
lidar.notes: Ultra-low power sensor. <5mA average at 1 Hz. Operates from 3.2V — direct LiPo cell compatible. Ideal for battery-constrained IoT and drone delivery.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare SF30/D
lidar.notes: LightWare's most potent rangefinder. 200m range, 20000 Hz update rate — fastest in lineup. Reliable altimetry over water surfaces. Lightest 200m LiDAR in the world.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare SF45/B
lidar.notes: World's smallest and lightest scanning LiDAR. Configurable FOV from a few degrees up to 320°. ArduPilot PRX1 proximity sensor support. Up to 5 sweeps/sec. Navigation commands built in.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare GRF-250
lidar.notes: Gimbal-integrated LRF for EO/IR payloads. Laser can be turned off for stealth/NVG-invisible ops. 3 mounting points for boresight alignment.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare GRF-500
lidar.notes: LightWare's furthest-ranging sensor. 500m gimbal LRF at 10.7g. Laser disable for NVG-invisible stealth ops. Multi-target discrimination (up to 5 targets). ISO9001 production. Lightest 500m LiDAR in the world.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare SF20/HA
lidar.notes: High-accuracy variant of SF20/C. Lightest 100m distance sensor in the world at 7.8g. Enhanced precision for demanding applications.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare SF30/C
lidar.notes: Versatile 100m sensor from the 20kHz family. Same physical package as SF30/D but 100m range instead of 200m. Well suited for high-speed drone and industrial sensing applications.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: LightWare SF40/C
lidar.notes: Full 360° 2D scanning LiDAR for SLAM. 5.5 rev/sec max. Configurable alarms for proactive obstacle notification. Can be extended to 3D scanning with additional degree of motion. Visualized via LightWare Studio.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by LightWare LiDAR. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: RESEPI GEN-II OS1-ILX
lidar.type: Integrated LiDAR + INS + RGB mapping payload
lidar.range_condition: Ouster OS1-64 rated range; operational AGL up to 75m recommended
lidar.notes: GEN-II flagship with Ouster OS1-64 + 61MP Sony ILX-LR1. Tactical-grade Kernel-210 IMU. 175% more compute and 700% more memory vs RESEPI LITE. Supports external IMU, wheel encoders, ADC aiding inputs. Field-swappable mounts. NDAA compliant. White-label platform — hardware and all software can carry partner branding.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by Inertial Labs. m range. channels. points/sec.
lidar.ndaa_note: Inertial Labs Inc., Paeonian Springs VA. US GNSS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

lidar.name: RESEPI GEN-II M2X-ILX
lidar.type: Integrated LiDAR + INS + RGB mapping payload
lidar.range_condition: Hesai XT-32M2X rated; recommended AGL up to 150m
lidar.notes: GEN-II with Hesai XT-32M2X. Higher AGL ceiling (150m) and better vertical accuracy (2-3cm) than OS1-ILX variant due to Hesai scanner characteristics. Lower power draw (25W vs 29W). Otherwise identical compute/INS/camera stack to OS1-ILX. NDAA compliant.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by Inertial Labs. m range. channels. points/sec.
lidar.ndaa_note: Inertial Labs Inc., Paeonian Springs VA. US GNSS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

lidar.name: RESEPI LITE XT-32
lidar.type: Integrated LiDAR + INS + RGB mapping payload
lidar.notes: Workhorse LITE line — most widely deployed RESEPI variant globally. Wide weight range (0.9-4.3kg) reflects different scanner/config options. Single-button operation or web UI. Modular: user can supply own GNSS receiver and/or LiDAR. NDAA compliant. White-label ready.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by Inertial Labs. m range. channels. points/sec.
lidar.ndaa_note: Inertial Labs Inc., Paeonian Springs VA. US GNSS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

lidar.name: RESEPI Ultra LITE
lidar.type: Integrated LiDAR + INS compact mapping payload
lidar.notes: Lowest-SWaP RESEPI. Built on LITE architecture, single antenna INS (vs dual on LITE/GEN-II). SnapFit mount for quick swap. 1.2kg — suitable for smaller platforms where LITE/GEN-II 1.7kg+ is a payload constraint. NDAA compliant.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by Inertial Labs. m range. channels. points/sec.
lidar.ndaa_note: Inertial Labs Inc., Paeonian Springs VA. US GNSS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

lidar.name: Teledyne EchoONE
lidar.type: Integrated LiDAR + INS + RGB mapping payload
lidar.range_condition: Teledyne scanner; up to 205m AGL recommended
lidar.notes: Teledyne-branded product powered by Inertial Labs RESEPI GEN-II platform. Teledyne Geospatial scanner provides sub-centimeter (0.5cm) data precision — highest in the RESEPI family. 205m AGL ceiling, highest of any RESEPI variant. NDAA compliant. Power-hungry at 75W (vs 25-29W for GEN-II variants). SnapFit mount. Optional Sony ILX-LR1 camera upgrade.
lidar.description: LiDAR sensor by Teledyne / Inertial Labs. m range. channels. points/sec.

lidar.name: Ouster OS0 (Short-Range LiDAR)
lidar.description: Ultra-wide 90° vertical FOV. Ideal for near-field robotics and drone landing.
lidar.ndaa_note: Ouster Inc., San Francisco CA (merged with Velodyne). US LiDAR (NYSE: OUST). NDAA compliant.

lidar.name: Ouster OS1 (Mid-Range LiDAR)
lidar.description: Versatile mid-range 3D LiDAR. Most popular for drone SLAM and mapping.
lidar.ndaa_note: Ouster Inc., San Francisco CA (merged with Velodyne). US LiDAR (NYSE: OUST). NDAA compliant.

lidar.name: Ouster OS2 (Long-Range LiDAR)
lidar.description: Long-range 3D LiDAR. Highway mapping, perimeter security, large-area survey.
lidar.ndaa_note: Ouster Inc., San Francisco CA (merged with Velodyne). US LiDAR (NYSE: OUST). NDAA compliant.

lidar.name: Ouster REV7 (Latest Generation)
lidar.description: Latest generation digital LiDAR. Improved range, resolution, and reliability.
lidar.ndaa_note: Ouster Inc., San Francisco CA (merged with Velodyne). US LiDAR (NYSE: OUST). NDAA compliant.

lidar.name: Livox Mid-360
lidar.description: 360° non-repetitive scanning. Budget drone SLAM sensor.

compliance.note: DJI subsidiary (Shenzhen, China). NOT NDAA compliant.

lidar.name: Livox Avia
lidar.description: Aerial mapping LiDAR. 320m range. Triple-return capability.

compliance.note: DJI subsidiary (Shenzhen, China). NOT NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Intelligent Energy IE-SOAR 800W
propulsion.description: Air-cooled PEM hydrogen fuel cell at 800W. Modular architecture scales to 24 kW. Set flight endurance record of 12 hours 7 minutes. Designed for Group 2-3 UAS requiring multi-hour endurance.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Intelligent Energy, Loughborough, UK. Allied-nation fuel cell manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Intelligent Energy IE-SOAR 2.4kW
propulsion.description: High-power air-cooled PEM fuel cell at 2.4 kW for larger UAS platforms. Same modular IE-SOAR architecture. Suitable for Group 3 platforms requiring significant endurance with heavier payloads.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Intelligent Energy, Loughborough, UK. Allied-nation fuel cell manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Doosan DP30 — Hydrogen Fuel Cell
propulsion.description: World's first mass-produced hydrogen fuel cell for drones. 2.6 kW output, 120-150 minute flights. South Korean manufacture. Proven in commercial applications. Allied-nation supply chain.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Doosan Mobility Innovation, Seoul, South Korea. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: HES Aerostak — Lightweight Fuel Cell
propulsion.description: Lightweight hydrogen fuel cell stack designed for long-endurance UAS. Singapore-based. Optimized for weight-critical applications.
propulsion.ndaa_note: HES Energy Systems, Singapore. Allied-nation (Five Eyes adjacent). NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Ballard/Honeywell FCair 650W
propulsion.description: 600-1200W PEM fuel cell from Ballard, integrated by Honeywell for defense applications. 41 g/hr H2 consumption at 650W. Canadian/US supply chain ensures NDAA compliance.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Ballard Power Systems (TSX: BLDP), Burnaby BC, Canada + Honeywell. Five Eyes allied-nation. NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Skyfront Perimeter 8 G2K — Gasoline-Electric Hybrid
propulsion.description: Blue UAS Select gasoline-electric hybrid powertrain. 5+ hours stock endurance, world record 13 hours 4 minutes / 205 miles. Gas generator charges electric motors for multi-rotor flight. US manufactured.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Skyfront Inc., San Jose CA. US hybrid/gasoline drone manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Quaternium HYBRiX — 2-Stroke Hybrid
propulsion.description: 2-stroke ICE hybrid multirotor powertrain. World record 10 hours 14 minutes endurance. Spanish manufacture. Popular for commercial long-endurance survey and inspection missions.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Quaternium, Valencia, Spain. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant. HYBRiX hybrid drone.

propulsion.name: NWUAV NW-44 — Multi-Fuel EFI Engine
propulsion.description: 43.6cc single-cylinder EFI engine at 3.5 HP and 3.4 kg. Multi-fuel capable (JP-5/JP-8/gasoline). 28,000+ operational hours, 18,000+ engines delivered, 1M+ fleet flight hours. The proven standard for US military small UAS propulsion. US manufactured, NDAA compliant.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Northwest UAV, McMinnville OR. US propulsion manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

propulsion.name: NWUAV NW-88 — Twin-Cylinder Engine
propulsion.description: Twin-cylinder variant for 40-75 kg aircraft class. Higher power output for heavier Group 3 platforms. Same multi-fuel EFI capability and US defense pedigree as NW-44.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Northwest UAV, McMinnville OR. US propulsion manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

propulsion.name: UAV Turbines Monarch 5 — Microturbine
propulsion.description: ~50 HP turboprop microturbine running heavy fuel (JP-5/JP-8). 100,000 RPM core. US Army contract. Designed for Group 3-4 fixed-wing UAS requiring turbine-class performance with heavy fuel logistics compatibility.
propulsion.ndaa_note: UAV Turbines Inc., Ogden UT. US turbine manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Currawong Corvid-29 — EFI Engine
propulsion.description: 29cc EFI engine with 700+ systems fielded on Honeywell T-Hawk and other platforms. Australian manufacture — Five Eyes supply chain. Proven reliability in defense applications.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Currawong Engineering, Sydney, Australia. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Currawong Corvid-50 — Heavy-Lift EFI Engine
propulsion.description: 50cc EFI engine for larger UAS platforms. Higher power variant of the proven Corvid architecture. Australian Five Eyes supply chain.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Currawong Engineering, Sydney, Australia. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

propulsion.name: Rotron RT600 — Zero-Vibration Wankel
propulsion.description: Zero-vibration Wankel rotary engine at 53-100 HP, 7,500 RPM. Multi-fuel capable. Rotary architecture eliminates vibration that disrupts sensors and payloads. UK manufacture.
propulsion.ndaa_note: UAV Engines Ltd (Rotron Power), Lichfield, UK. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Wankel rotary engines.

propulsion.name: Hirth F33 — 2-Stroke UAS Engine
propulsion.description: Proven 2-stroke engine for UAS applications. Part of Hirth's extensive engine family for unmanned systems. German manufacture — NATO/EU supply chain.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Hirth Engines GmbH, Benningen, Germany. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant. 2-stroke UAS engines.

propulsion.name: TEI PD-170 — Turbodiesel
propulsion.description: 170 HP turbodiesel engine: 2.1L, twin-turbo, heavy fuel (JP-8). Powers TB3 and AKSUNGUR UAS. Serial production since 2020. Turkish indigenous propulsion — eliminates foreign engine dependence for tactical UAS.
propulsion.ndaa_note: TEI — TUSAŞ Engine Industries, Eskişehir, Turkey. NATO member but Turkey S-400 complication. Verify per contract.

propulsion.name: Ivchenko-Progress AI-322F — Afterburning Turbofan
propulsion.description: 44 kN afterburning turbofan engine. Powers Baykar Kızılelma jet UCAV. Ukrainian-designed, representing decades of Soviet/Ukrainian turbine expertise. Largest engine in the UAS propulsion database.
propulsion.ndaa_note: Ivchenko-Progress / Motor Sich, Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine. Allied-nation NDAA compliant — Ukraine is a US defense partner under active support frameworks.

propulsion.name: Draganfuel Ignite 70cc
propulsion.description: Hybrid gas-electric power unit for heavy multirotor UAVs approaching the 25kg limit. 4000W output. Liquid-cooled. Fuel-injected for reliable starts at any altitude and environment. Runs gasoline or heavy fuel. Fully autonomous operation — self-starting, self-regulating. Onboard diagnostics. Powers all UAV systems while managing battery state of charge. Primary propulsion unit for Commander 3XL Hybrid.

sensors.name: Ouster OS1 — Mid-Range Lidar
sensors.description: Digital lidar with 5.2M points/sec, 240m range, 360° FOV. 447g, IP68/IP69K rated. REV7 sensor with up to 128 channels. NDAA compliant, US manufactured. Standard for UAS mapping and autonomous navigation.
sensors.ndaa_note: Ouster Inc., San Francisco CA (merged with Velodyne). US LiDAR (NYSE: OUST). NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Ouster OS0 — Short-Range Wide-FOV Lidar
sensors.description: Ultra-wide 90° vertical FOV lidar optimized for close-range perception and robotics. Same digital architecture as OS1. Ideal for obstacle avoidance and indoor navigation on UAS.
sensors.ndaa_note: Ouster Inc., San Francisco CA (merged with Velodyne). US LiDAR (NYSE: OUST). NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Ouster OS2 — Long-Range Lidar
sensors.description: Long-range variant optimized for 200+ meter detection. Narrow vertical FOV focused on distant object detection. Suited for infrastructure inspection, corridor mapping, and perimeter security from UAS.
sensors.ndaa_note: Ouster Inc., San Francisco CA (merged with Velodyne). US LiDAR (NYSE: OUST). NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: RIEGL miniVUX-1UAV — Survey-Grade Airborne Lidar
sensors.description: Survey-grade airborne laser scanner at 1.55 kg. 100 kHz pulse rate, 330m range, eye-safe Class 1. Designed for UAV-based topographic mapping with centimeter accuracy. Austrian manufacture, NATO-aligned.
sensors.ndaa_note: RIEGL Laser Measurement Systems, Horn, Austria. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: RIEGL VUX-120²³ — High-Performance Airborne Scanner
sensors.description: High-performance airborne laser scanner at 2 kg with 1.8 MHz effective measurement rate, 720m operating altitude, 10mm accuracy. Multi-target echo processing. Professional survey and mapping standard.
sensors.ndaa_note: RIEGL Laser Measurement Systems, Horn, Austria. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: YellowScan Voyager — Integrated Lidar+INS
sensors.description: Integrated lidar mapping solution combining RIEGL scanner with INS and processing software. 2M usable points/sec, 1cm accuracy. Turnkey solution for professional UAV surveying.
sensors.ndaa_note: YellowScan, Montpellier, France. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Livox Mid-360 — Budget Lidar
sensors.description: Budget 360° lidar at only 265g and $600-900. Non-repetitive scanning pattern provides high point density over time. Strong price-to-performance ratio but Chinese manufacture — NOT NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Ainstein US-D1 — Radar Altimeter
sensors.description: 24 GHz radar altimeter with 50m range, ±6cm accuracy, 100 Hz update rate. 110g, IP67. UART/CAN interface. NDAA compliant, ITAR-free. Standard radar altimeter for ArduPilot/PX4 platforms. US manufactured.
sensors.ndaa_note: Ainstein Inc., Lawrence KS. US radar altimeter manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Echodyne EchoGuard — Metamaterial ESA Radar
sensors.description: Metamaterial electronically scanned array (ESA) radar that detects DJI Phantom-4 class drones at ~1 km and vehicles at 3.5 km. 1.25 kg, 120°x80° FOV, under 50W. No mechanical scanning parts. NDAA compliant. Used for airspace awareness and counter-UAS detection.
sensors.ndaa_note: Echodyne Corp, Kirkland WA. US metamaterial radar. NDAA compliant. Backed by Gates Ventures/Vulcan.

sensors.name: Echodyne EchoGuard CR — 360° Radar
sensors.description: 360° coverage variant of EchoGuard using multiple metamaterial ESA panels. Provides full-hemisphere drone detection and tracking for persistent airspace monitoring.
sensors.ndaa_note: Echodyne Corp, Kirkland WA. US metamaterial radar. NDAA compliant. Backed by Gates Ventures/Vulcan.

sensors.name: Advanced Navigation Motus — MEMS IMU
sensors.description: Breakthrough MEMS IMU achieving 0.2°/hr gyro bias instability — approaching FOG-grade performance from MEMS technology. Only 26g. Massive cost and weight reduction vs fiber-optic gyros for defense-grade navigation.
sensors.ndaa_note: Advanced Navigation, Sydney, Australia. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: SBG Systems Quanta Micro — Tactical INS
sensors.description: Compact tactical-grade INS at approximately 50g with 0.8°/hr gyro bias. Integrates GNSS receiver for full navigation solution. French manufacture — EU/NATO sovereign supply chain.
sensors.ndaa_note: SBG Systems, Rueil-Malmaison, France. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: SBG Systems Pulse-40 — Ultra-Miniature INS
sensors.description: Ultra-miniature tactical-grade INS at only 12g and 0.3W. Designed for micro-UAS and precision-guided munitions where SWaP is extreme. Includes GNSS and dual-antenna heading.
sensors.ndaa_note: SBG Systems, Rueil-Malmaison, France. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: SBG Systems Ellipse-D — Dual-Antenna INS/GNSS
sensors.description: Dual-antenna RTK INS/GNSS providing centimeter-level positioning and precise heading without magnetometer. Standard for UAS survey and mapping applications. French manufacture.
sensors.ndaa_note: SBG Systems, Rueil-Malmaison, France. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: VectorNav VN-100 — AHRS/IMU
sensors.description: Compact AHRS/IMU with under 10°/hr gyro bias in under 30g package. Industry standard for commercial UAS attitude reference. US manufactured, NDAA compliant.
sensors.ndaa_note: VectorNav Technologies, Dallas TX. US AHRS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: VectorNav VN-200 — GPS/INS
sensors.description: Integrated GPS/INS module providing position, velocity, and attitude. Kalman filter fuses MEMS IMU with GNSS. Mid-range solution between VN-100 AHRS and VN-300 dual-antenna.
sensors.ndaa_note: VectorNav Technologies, Dallas TX. US AHRS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: VectorNav VN-300 — Dual-Antenna GPS/INS
sensors.description: Dual-antenna GPS/INS providing precise heading and position without magnetometer. Highest-performance VectorNav solution for UAS and autonomous systems.
sensors.ndaa_note: VectorNav Technologies, Dallas TX. US AHRS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Inertial Labs INS-D/P — Defense INS
sensors.description: Defense-grade INS systems for UAS platforms. INS-D for dual-antenna heading, INS-P for precision navigation. US manufactured with NDAA compliance. Supports PX4/ArduPilot integration.
sensors.ndaa_note: Inertial Labs Inc., Paeonian Springs VA. US GNSS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

sensors.name: ARK Electronics Flow MR — Optical Flow Sensor
sensors.description: Mid-range optical flow sensor for GPS-denied positioning. Blue UAS Framework listed. MEMS IMU integrated (Analog Devices/Murata). Made in USA. Provides visual odometry for indoor and GNSS-denied flight.
sensors.ndaa_note: Designed and manufactured USA. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: KVH 1750 IMU — FOG
sensors.description: Fiber-optic gyro IMU with under 0.05°/hr bias instability. Gold standard for high-accuracy navigation in defense UAS. Significantly heavier and more expensive than MEMS but provides gyro performance 10-100x better.
sensors.ndaa_note: KVH Industries, Middletown RI (NASDAQ: KVHI). US FOG IMU manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: MicaSense RedEdge-P — Multispectral Camera
sensors.description: 5-band multispectral camera plus 5.1 MP panchromatic for UAS precision agriculture and environmental monitoring. 300g. NDAA compliant, DIU approved. Industry standard for agricultural remote sensing.
sensors.ndaa_note: MicaSense, acquired by AgEagle Aerial Systems, Wichita KS. US manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: MicaSense Altum-PT — Multispectral + Thermal
sensors.description: Combined multispectral (5 bands) plus 320x256 thermal sensor for simultaneous crop stress and temperature mapping. Adds FLIR thermal to RedEdge capabilities. NDAA compliant.
sensors.ndaa_note: MicaSense, acquired by AgEagle Aerial Systems, Wichita KS. US manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Sentera 6X — Multi-Sensor Camera
sensors.description: 6-sensor payload with 5x 3.2 MP multispectral cameras plus 20 MP RGB plus optional FLIR Boson thermal. 290g. NDAA compliant, DIU approved. Designed for precision agriculture and defense ISR on small UAS.
sensors.ndaa_note: Sentera, Minneapolis MN — acquired by John Deere May 2025. US manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Livox Avia — Solid-State LiDAR (FAST-LIO reference)
sensors.description: Non-repetitive scanning solid-state LiDAR with 70° circular FoV. The reference sensor for FAST-LIO/FAST-LIVO SLAM stacks from HKU-MARS lab. Triple-return, 240K points/sec, integrated IMU. Used on DJI Matrice 300/350 and custom research quads.

sensors.name: Livox Mid-360 — Budget 360° LiDAR
sensors.description: 360° non-repetitive solid-state LiDAR at budget price point. Inertial-grade IMU, 200K pts/sec. Popular for GPS-denied indoor navigation builds. Compatible with FAST-LIO2, Point-LIO.

sensors.name: Livox Horizon — Wide-FoV Solid-State LiDAR
sensors.description: 81.7° x 25.1° FoV solid-state LiDAR, automotive-grade. Used in L4 autonomous driving and large drone mapping. FAST-LIO compatible.

sensors.name: RoboSense RS-Helios — 32-Channel Spinning LiDAR
sensors.description: 32-channel mechanical spinning LiDAR with 360° FoV. Used in S-FAST_LIO RS-LiDAR configuration (zlwang7). 70m range, compact form factor for drone integration.
sensors.ndaa_note: RoboSense (Suteng Innovation Technology), Shenzhen, China. Non-NDAA. Chinese LiDAR manufacturer.

sensors.name: Velodyne VLP-16 (Puck) — 16-Channel Spinning LiDAR
sensors.description: Industry-standard 16-channel spinning LiDAR. 100m range, 300K pts/sec. The most commonly used LiDAR in drone SLAM research. Supported by virtually all SLAM stacks.
sensors.ndaa_note: Velodyne Lidar merged with Ouster 2023. Ouster Inc., San Francisco CA (NYSE: OUST). US company. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Xsens MTi-30 — Tactical-Grade IMU
sensors.description: MEMS IMU used paired with RS-Helios in S-FAST_LIO RS-LiDAR datasets. 400Hz gyro/accel, AHRS output. Common external IMU for LiDAR-inertial SLAM when LiDAR lacks built-in IMU.
sensors.ndaa_note: Xsens/Movella, Enschede, Netherlands. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Inertial Labs INS-B — GPS-Aided Inertial Navigation System (Basic)
sensors.description: Tactical-grade single-antenna GPS-aided INS. Ideal for LiDAR/optical camera UAV payloads. 0.1 deg dynamic heading accuracy, 1.5m horizontal position (GPS L1), 1cm+1ppm RTK. Supports NovAtel OEM719, u-blox ZED-F9P, or Septentrio mosaic-X5. IP67, MIL-STD-810G. Compatible with Pixhawk autopilot and COBHAM AVIATOR UAV 200. 'Tunnel Guide' feature: 0.2% DT position accuracy in GNSS-denied environments.

sensors.name: Inertial Labs INS-P — GPS-Aided INS with Fluxgate Compass (Professional)
sensors.description: Professional tactical-grade GPS-aided INS with embedded gyro-compensated Fluxgate compass — maintains heading without GNSS. 0.3 deg static heading accuracy, 0.1 deg dynamic. Key differentiator: free-inertial heading to <0.4 deg (3-sigma) in GPS-denied ops. Industrial-grade IMU variant of the same form factor. Supports Pixhawk. RESEPI LiDAR integration-ready.

sensors.name: Inertial Labs INS-D — Dual Antenna GPS-Aided INS
sensors.description: Dual-antenna GPS-aided INS for high-precision heading without magnetic compass. 0.15 deg heading accuracy at 1m baseline (NovAtel OEM7720) or 0.4 deg at 1m (dual u-blox ZED-F9P). 1cm RTK. Tactical-grade IMU. Used on ISR fixed-wing platforms and precision survey drones requiring heading independent of magnetic environment.

sensors.name: Inertial Labs AHRS-10P — MEMS Attitude & Heading Reference System
sensors.description: Compact MEMS AHRS with fluxgate magnetometers. 0.6 deg dynamic heading accuracy, 0.08 deg pitch/roll. 90 x 27 x 26mm, 84g. Interfaces: RS-232, RS-422, CAN. IP67. Designed for UAVs, gimbals, antenna pointing, and stabilization systems where full GPS-aided INS is overkill. ITAR-free.

sensors.name: Inertial Labs AHRS-II-P — Tactical-Grade Attitude & Heading Reference System
sensors.description: Tactical-grade AHRS with Inertial Labs 8mm fluxgate magnetometers — superior stability over MEMS magnetics. 0.6 deg gyro-stabilized heading, 0.08 deg pitch/roll dynamic accuracy over full temperature range. Kalman filter based algorithms for UAV, aircraft, vessels, ROV, UGV. IP67. Used as standalone orientation reference where GPS weight/cost is prohibitive.

sensors.name: Inertial Labs M-AJ-QUATRO — CRPA Anti-Jamming Antenna System
sensors.description: Advanced CRPA (Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna) anti-jamming system for Assured PNT in GPS-jammed/spoofed environments. Operates on all L1, L2, L5 GNSS bands. Adaptive digital nulling: >34dB interference suppression (export-free model). Compatible with all Inertial Labs INS products and commercial GNSS receivers — plug-and-play integration. Released March 2025 (post-VIAVI acquisition). Targets military UAVs, loitering munitions, ISR platforms, commercial aviation.

sensors.name: ARK Electronics ARK Flow
sensors.description: Blue UAS listed DroneCAN optical flow + distance sensor for GPS-denied flight. PAW3902 optical flow (tracks >9 lux, 80mm to infinity, 7.4 rad/s max), Broadcom AFBR-S50LV85D ToF LiDAR (30m range, 12.4°x6.2° FoV, 32px), ICM-42688-P IMU. STM32F412, 2x CAN JST-GH. 3x3x1.4cm, 5g. Open source firmware + ROS2 support. USA made.

compliance.note: Blue UAS Framework listed. NDAA compliant. Made in USA.

sensors.ndaa_note: ARK Electronics, USA. Designed and manufactured USA. NDAA compliant.

sensors.name: Draganfly Long Range LiDAR
sensors.description: Survey-grade 360° scanning LiDAR for UAV, helicopter, vehicle, and backpack deployment. Teledyne 40-year aerospace sensor heritage. Applanix (Trimble) IMU+GNSS. 750m range at 50kHz. 2M pts/sec. 4 laser returns for bare-earth under thick vegetation. 0.5cm point cloud precision, 2cm global accuracy. Includes pre-processing software (LAS/LAZ output). LiDAR360 post-processing available. Used for Ukraine demining ops.

compliance.note: North American manufactured. Teledyne sensor used in commercial and military aerospace.

sources.title: Draganfly Long Range LiDAR product page

sensors.name: Draganfly Vital Intelligence
sensors.description: Software platform turning any RGB camera into a contactless biometric monitoring system. Extracts heart rate, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation (SpO2), and body temperature from standard video feed — no specialized hardware. API available for telehealth integrations. Deployable on drones, robots, kiosks, handheld devices, and edge computing platforms. Anonymized data option. Dashboard for real-time display. Deployed in corporate offices, correctional facilities, schools, restaurants, sheriff's offices across North America. COVID-era origin (symptom screening at scale).

specs.modality: RGB video (standard camera — no thermal required)
specs.chief_scientist: Prof. Javaan Chahl, Univ. of South Australia / Defense Science and Technology Chair

compliance.note: Software product. North American developed. No personal data registered.

sensors.description: 3-axis weatherproof gimbal stabilizer for outdoor/harsh-environment UAS operations.

sensors.name: GVI LiAir X3 LiDAR Mapping System
sensors.description: Integrated LiDAR + INS + 26MP camera for UAS mapping. 240k pts/s, AirPilot L3 autonomous flight, powerline inspection. Compatible with DJI M300 RTK.

thermal_cameras.name: Teledyne FLIR Boson 640
thermal_cameras.description: Industry-standard uncooled LWIR OEM thermal camera core with 640x512 VOx microbolometer at 12μm pitch. Sets the benchmark for SWaP in drone-integrated thermal imaging. Available in multiple lens configurations from 4.9mm (95° HFOV) to 73mm (5.5° HFOV). NDAA compliant and ITAR free, classified under EAR 6A003.b.4.a.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Teledyne Technologies, Goleta CA. June 2025: full NDAA compliance announced for Neutrino, Boson, Boson+, Hadron, Lepton lineup. Designed and assembled USA. ITAR-free.

thermal_cameras.name: Teledyne FLIR Boson+ 640
thermal_cameras.description: Enhanced sensitivity variant of the Boson 640 with industry-leading NEdT of less than 20 mK. Improved automatic gain control and scene-based NUC provide better image quality across a wider range of environments. Same form factor as standard Boson for drop-in upgrade compatibility.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Teledyne Technologies, Goleta CA. June 2025: full NDAA compliance announced for Neutrino, Boson, Boson+, Hadron, Lepton lineup. Designed and assembled USA. ITAR-free.

thermal_cameras.name: Teledyne FLIR Boson 320
thermal_cameras.description: Lower-resolution variant of the Boson family with 320x256 VOx uncooled detector at 12μm pitch. Cost-effective option for applications where full VGA thermal resolution is not required. Same mechanical and electrical compatibility as Boson 640 for easy swap between configurations.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Teledyne Technologies, Goleta CA. June 2025: full NDAA compliance announced for Neutrino, Boson, Boson+, Hadron, Lepton lineup. Designed and assembled USA. ITAR-free.

thermal_cameras.name: Teledyne FLIR Lepton 3.5
thermal_cameras.description: World's highest-volume LWIR micro thermal camera module, smaller than a dime at 0.9g. 160x120 pixels at 12μm pitch with radiometric output across all 19,200 pixels. Interfaces via SPI video and I2C-like CCI control. Scene dynamic range to +400°C. The definitive budget thermal OEM core for mobile and micro-drone integration.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Teledyne Technologies, Goleta CA. June 2025: full NDAA compliance announced for Neutrino, Boson, Boson+, Hadron, Lepton lineup. Designed and assembled USA. ITAR-free.

thermal_cameras.name: Teledyne FLIR Neutrino SX8
thermal_cameras.description: High-performance cooled MWIR camera engine for ISR applications. InSb detector with Stirling cooler provides superior sensitivity for long-range target detection and identification. Designed for integration into advanced gimbal payloads and defense ISR systems.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Teledyne Technologies, Goleta CA. June 2025: full NDAA compliance announced for Neutrino, Boson, Boson+, Hadron, Lepton lineup. Designed and assembled USA. ITAR-free.

thermal_cameras.name: Teledyne FLIR Vue TZ20-R
thermal_cameras.description: Dual-thermal-sensor integrated drone payload with radiometric capability. Features two Boson thermal cameras at different focal lengths for simultaneous wide and narrow FOV. Designed for DJI M300/M350 RTK integration with dual gimbal support. Purpose-built for drone inspection and public safety missions.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Teledyne Technologies, Goleta CA. June 2025: full NDAA compliance announced for Neutrino, Boson, Boson+, Hadron, Lepton lineup. Designed and assembled USA. ITAR-free.

thermal_cameras.name: Sierra-Olympic Vayu HD
thermal_cameras.description: World's highest-resolution uncooled LWIR camera with true 1920x1200 Full HD resolution from a 12μm VOx microbolometer array — 7.5x the pixel count of standard 640x512 sensors. Onboard H.264/H.265 processor, USB3.0 raw output, HDMI 1080p, and IP-video. Available in 25mm, 50mm, and 87mm lens configurations. Open chassis design optimized for drone and unmanned systems integration.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Sierra-Olympic Technologies, Hood River OR. US manufacturer of thermal cameras for defense/commercial UAS. NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: Sierra-Olympic Vayu HD-Industrial
thermal_cameras.description: Ruggedized variant of the Vayu HD enclosed in an IP54-rated case with sealed and locking connectors. Same 1920x1200 Full HD uncooled thermal sensor in a field-ready enclosure designed to withstand vibration and wide temperature ranges. Multiple mounting options for faster integration.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Sierra-Olympic Technologies, Hood River OR. US manufacturer of thermal cameras for defense/commercial UAS. NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: L3Harris WESCAM MX-10
thermal_cameras.description: Compact multi-sensor turret combining MWIR thermal and HD daylight cameras in a 17 kg stabilized gimbal. Standard payload for Group 2–3 UAS platforms requiring day/night ISR capability. Advanced image processing and target tracking with multiple video output formats.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: L3Harris Technologies, Melbourne FL. Major US defense contractor — 6th largest in US. All products inherently NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: L3Harris WESCAM MX-15HDi
thermal_cameras.description: Full multi-spectral ISR turret with MWIR cooled thermal, HD daylight spotter, laser rangefinder, and laser designator in a 45 kg stabilized gimbal. Proven on hundreds of military and law enforcement platforms worldwide. Capable of 10+ km target identification.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: L3Harris Technologies, Melbourne FL. Major US defense contractor — 6th largest in US. All products inherently NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: L3Harris WESCAM MX-20
thermal_cameras.description: Largest MX-series turret at 90 kg with 20+ km target identification capability. Full multi-spectral sensor suite including MWIR, SWIR, HD EO, LRF, and laser designator. Designed for MALE/HALE UAS and fixed-wing ISR aircraft. Combat-proven across multiple theaters.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: L3Harris Technologies, Melbourne FL. Major US defense contractor — 6th largest in US. All products inherently NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: Trillium Engineering HD25
thermal_cameras.description: Compact multi-sensor gimbal at only 300g featuring thermal and HD daylight cameras. Designed for Group 1 sUAS requiring the lightest possible stabilized EO/IR payload. Part of Trillium's HD series spanning 25 to 95 class turrets.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Trillium Engineering, Yucaipa CA. US manufacturer of EO/IR gimbals and payloads for UAS. NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: Trillium Engineering HD95
thermal_cameras.description: Full-capability stabilized multi-sensor turret at 5+ kg. STANAG 3733 rated for NATO interoperability. Selected for US Army Future Vertical Lift (FVL) program. Features cooled MWIR thermal, HD EO, and optional LRF/designator.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Trillium Engineering, Yucaipa CA. US manufacturer of EO/IR gimbals and payloads for UAS. NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: Seek Thermal Drone Core
thermal_cameras.description: Budget-tier uncooled thermal camera core specifically designed for drone integration. 320x240 resolution at 12μm pitch offers best price-per-pixel in its class. Available in 56° and 24° HFOV lens configurations. USB interface for straightforward integration.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Seek Thermal, Santa Barbara CA. US manufacturer. Consumer/commercial thermal cameras. NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: Controp Micro-STAMP
thermal_cameras.description: World's smallest gyro-stabilized dual-sensor payload at only 300g (65g sensor module). Combines uncooled IR and daylight cameras in a three-gimbal stabilized system. Designed for nano/micro UAS where every gram counts. Delivered to multiple defense customers worldwide.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Controp Precision Technologies, Yehud, Israel. Allied-nation manufacturer. Israel is a major US defense partner. NDAA compliant under allied-nation supply chain.

thermal_cameras.name: Controp M-STAMP
thermal_cameras.description: Multi-sensor stabilized miniature payload at 1.3 kg combining uncooled 8-12μm IR camera with continuous zoom lens, HD CMOS day camera, and laser pointer. Three-axis gyro-stabilized gimbal for sUAS tactical over-the-hill reconnaissance missions.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Controp Precision Technologies, Yehud, Israel. Allied-nation manufacturer. Israel is a major US defense partner. NDAA compliant under allied-nation supply chain.

thermal_cameras.name: Controp T-STAMP XR
thermal_cameras.description: Triple-sensor stabilized payload at 3.5 kg with cooled 3-5μm MWIR thermal camera (640x512, 15μm, continuous zoom x15), HD day camera (zoom x17), and optional laser designator (1064nm, 10mJ, 1km NATO range). Built-in INS provides geo-location and hold-to-coordinate capability. Delivers optical performance of much larger payloads from small UAS platforms.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Controp Precision Technologies, Yehud, Israel. Allied-nation manufacturer. Israel is a major US defense partner. NDAA compliant under allied-nation supply chain.

thermal_cameras.name: Elbit Systems Mini-POP
thermal_cameras.description: Compact cooled MWIR multi-sensor payload at 3.5 kg for tactical UAS. Features cooled 3-5μm InSb detector, HD day camera, and optional laser designator. Combat-proven across multiple armed forces and integrated into numerous UAS platforms including Hermes family.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Elbit Systems, Haifa, Israel. Major Israeli defense contractor and direct US DoD supplier. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. US subsidiary: Elbit Systems of America.

thermal_cameras.name: Elbit Systems Micro-POP
thermal_cameras.description: Ultra-compact multi-sensor payload at 1.5 kg for small tactical UAS. Lighter variant of the Mini-POP optimized for Group 1–2 platforms. Maintains cooled thermal imaging capability in a significantly smaller form factor.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Elbit Systems, Haifa, Israel. Major Israeli defense contractor and direct US DoD supplier. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. US subsidiary: Elbit Systems of America.

thermal_cameras.name: Rafael TopLite
thermal_cameras.description: Large-format (15-20 inch) multi-sensor turret for medium-altitude UAS platforms. Integrated into Hermes 450/900 and similar MALE UAS. Features cooled MWIR/LWIR thermal, HD EO, LRF, and laser designator. Combat-proven in multiple theaters. STANAG-compliant video outputs.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Rafael Advanced Defense Systems, Haifa, Israel. Israeli state-owned defense company. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Co-produces Iron Dome with Raytheon.

thermal_cameras.name: Aselsan ASELFLIR-600
thermal_cameras.description: Turkey's flagship indigenous EO/IR turret with 1280x1024 HD cooled MWIR sensor, 325mm Cassegrain optics, 4-axis gimbal stabilization, and AI-enabled target recognition. Entered serial production early 2026. Eliminates Turkey's dependence on foreign EO/IR systems. Designed for TB3, AKSUNGUR, and ANKA-3 UAS platforms.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Aselsan, Ankara, Turkey. Turkish state defense company. Turkey is NATO member but has complex US relationship (F-35 exclusion over S-400 purchase). NDAA status uncertain — verify per contract. Do not assume NDAA compliant without contracting officer review.

thermal_cameras.name: Aselsan CATS
thermal_cameras.description: Common aperture targeting system family for Turkish tactical UAS. Multiple variants from compact sUAS payloads to full multi-sensor turrets. Proven on Bayraktar TB2 and ANKA platforms. Features uncooled and cooled thermal variants with integrated laser systems.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Aselsan, Ankara, Turkey. Turkish state defense company. Turkey is NATO member but has complex US relationship (F-35 exclusion over S-400 purchase). NDAA status uncertain — verify per contract. Do not assume NDAA compliant without contracting officer review.

thermal_cameras.name: Workswell WIRIS Pro
thermal_cameras.description: Fully radiometric dual-sensor drone thermal camera with 640x512 LWIR at 50 mK sensitivity (30 mK optional) and Super Resolution to 1266x1010. Full HD RGB camera with 10x optical zoom. Runs WIRIS OS for full in-flight control. Under 430g with internal 128/256 GB SSD. MAVLink compatible. Czech/EU manufactured — the go-to non-Chinese integrated thermal payload for commercial drone operations.
thermal_cameras.interface: Ethernet (RJ45) / USB / Wi-Fi / MAVLink / UART / CAN
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Workswell s.r.o., Prague, Czech Republic. EU/NATO member. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: Workswell WIRIS Pro Sc
thermal_cameras.description: Scientific-grade variant of the WIRIS Pro with standard 30 mK sensitivity (vs 50 mK on Pro). Each unit calibrated in climatic chamber for precision temperature measurement across operating conditions. Designed for research applications requiring highest accuracy: geological surveys, environmental monitoring, precision agriculture. Under 450g.
thermal_cameras.interface: Ethernet (RJ45) / USB / Wi-Fi / MAVLink / UART / CAN
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Workswell s.r.o., Prague, Czech Republic. EU/NATO member. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: Workswell WIRIS Enterprise
thermal_cameras.description: Multi-sensor aerial camera with 640x512 thermal (Super Resolution to 1266x1010), 16MP RGB for mapping, and Full HD with 10x zoom. Designed for security, firefighting, forestry, and environmental applications. WIRIS OS with full in-flight control and streaming. Ethernet integration for command and data.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Workswell s.r.o., Prague, Czech Republic. EU/NATO member. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

thermal_cameras.name: Gremsy Vio F1
thermal_cameras.description: Multi-sensor gimbal payload integrating FLIR Boson 640 thermal core, Sony 4K camera with 20x optical zoom, and 2,400m laser rangefinder. Total weight 854g. F1 variant assembled in the US with FLIR Boson is NDAA-compliant. Designed for inspection, security, and search and rescue on commercial drone platforms.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Gremsy, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Gimbal/payload manufacturer. Vietnam is not an adversary nation but not a formal US allied nation under NDAA framework. Gremsy Lynx/ORUS-L NDAA payloads use Teledyne FLIR Boson+ (NDAA compliant core) — but the gimbal assembly itself is Vietnam-manufactured. Verify per specific product and contracting requirements.

thermal_cameras.name: Lynred Pico384
thermal_cameras.description: Compact uncooled LWIR detector core at 384x288 resolution with 17μm pixel pitch. Manufactured by Lynred (50% Thales / 50% Safran joint venture), the leading European IR detector foundry. Designed as OEM building block for European/NATO defense programs requiring sovereign supply chain.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Lynred (formerly Sofradir-EC), Palaiseau, France. Joint venture Thales/Safran — major French defense companies. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant. Supplies FPAs to FLIR, L3Harris, and others.

thermal_cameras.name: Lynred ATom1024
thermal_cameras.description: High-resolution uncooled LWIR detector with 1024x768 resolution. Part of Lynred's ATom family spanning from 160x120 to 1280x1024 formats across LWIR, MWIR, and SWIR spectral bands. European sovereign IR supply for defense and commercial programs. Thales/Safran JV ensures NATO-aligned supply chain.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Lynred (formerly Sofradir-EC), Palaiseau, France. Joint venture Thales/Safran — major French defense companies. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant. Supplies FPAs to FLIR, L3Harris, and others.

thermal_cameras.name: Leonardo DRS IR Systems
thermal_cameras.description: Defense-grade IR detector and camera systems for military UAS and vehicle programs. Leonardo DRS (US subsidiary of Italian Leonardo S.p.A.) manufactures advanced cooled and uncooled focal plane arrays for US defense prime contractors. Products include Talon uncooled cores and cooled MWIR/LWIR systems for tactical to strategic ISR.
thermal_cameras.ndaa_note: Leonardo DRS, Arlington VA. US subsidiary of Leonardo S.p.A. (Italy). DoD prime contractor. NDAA compliant — US-based operations and supply chain.

thermal_cameras.name: InfiRay Micro III 640
thermal_cameras.description: Budget-mid OEM uncooled LWIR core at 640x512 resolution with 12μm pixel pitch and sub-25 mK NETD. Competitive sensitivity at a fraction of Western core pricing. thermal_cameras.name: DJI Zenmuse H30T
thermal_cameras.description: Integrated quad-sensor payload with 1280x1024 radiometric thermal, wide-angle and zoom visible cameras, and laser rangefinder. Designed for DJI Matrice 350 RTK. swarm_software.name: DSSE (Drone Swarm Search Environment)
swarm_software.description: PettingZoo-based multi-agent RL training environment for SAR drone swarm missions. Drones search for shipwrecked people using dynamic probability matrices. Published in JOSS + arXiv (2307.06240). pip install DSSE.

environments.DroneSwarmSearch: Maritime SAR — drones search for shipwrecked people on dynamic probability matrix. Gaussian dispersion model with drift vector. 9 discrete actions (8 directions + SEARCH). Reward: +1 for finding target, 0 otherwise.
environments.CoverageDroneSwarmSearch: Coverage mission — drones must visit all cells on a probability grid generated by Lagrangian particle simulation (OpenDrift). Uses real ocean/wind data. Reward: +1 per new cell searched, +60 completion bonus, -0.2 per step.

architecture.action_space: Discrete(9): LEFT, RIGHT, UP, DOWN, UP_LEFT, UP_RIGHT, DOWN_LEFT, DOWN_RIGHT, SEARCH

simulation.probability_matrix: Gaussian probability field centered on disaster position. Drifts with configurable vector. Dispersion increases over time (configurable increment). Numba JIT-compiled for speed.
simulation.particle_simulation: OpenDrift-based Lagrangian particle simulation. 50,000 particles, configurable radius. Uses real ocean current and wind data for realistic drift patterns.
simulation.time_step: Derived from drone_speed and cell_size — faster drones get fewer environment steps per real second.

wrappers: AllPositionsWrapper: Returns all drone positions in observation

ppo_cnn.model: Dual-branch: Conv2d(1→16, 8x8) → Conv2d(16→32, 4x4) → FC(256) for probability matrix + FC(512→256) for position → Concat → FC(256) → Policy + Value heads

decentralized_ppo.description: Each drone has its own policy network (1:1 agent→module mapping). Same CNN architecture but independently trained per agent. MultiAgentRLModuleSpec.

rl_algorithms.ppo_cnn_lstm: PPO with CNN + LSTM for temporal context (sequence-aware search)
rl_algorithms.ppo_cnn_comm: PPO with CNN + inter-drone communication channel
rl_algorithms.ppo_mlp: PPO with MLP (no CNN) — position-only baseline
rl_algorithms.greedy_heuristic: Greedy: each drone moves toward highest probability cell. Collision avoidance by waiting. Baseline for RL comparison.
rl_algorithms.a_star_coverage: A* path planning for coverage mission

specs.org_description: Projeto Final de Engenharia (Capstone) — Insper, São Paulo, Brazil. Engineering + CS capstone projects including DSSE (drone swarm SAR), NVIDIA Jetbot autopilot, RISC-V CPU, RFID testing.

NVIDIA_Jetbot_Autopilot.description: Autonomous car MVP on Jetson Nano. Lane detection (OpenCV yellow mask + linear regression), YOLOv3-tiny stop sign detection, MQTT pub/sub architecture, DeepStream SDK, TensorRT. Brazilian traffic sign recognition.
NVIDIA_Jetbot_Autopilot.hardware: Jetson Nano + Jetbot chassis + USB camera

techniques.lane_detection: Yellow mask (LUT thresholding on R+G-B channel) → morphological open → contour centroids → linear regression for lane line → steering gain from centroid offset
techniques.sign_detection: YOLOv3-tiny (416x416, conf>0.2) filtered for 'stop sign' class → MQTT publish 'STOP' command
techniques.road_following: Hough line transform on white mask → angular coefficient filtering (0.62-1.3 for right, -1.3 to -0.62 for left) → vanishing point estimation → MQTT steering commands
techniques.architecture: Perception (camera) → Detection (YOLO/lane) → MQTT broker → Controller (motor commands). Fully decoupled via pub/sub.

swarm_software.name: ORCUS (Autonomous Swarm Kamikaze System)
swarm_software.description: Fully autonomous swarm kamikaze drone system. YOLOv12 detection, ray-ground intersection geo-localization, EKF multi-drone sensor fusion, Hungarian attack assignment, 7-step handshake attack protocol, IBVS terminal guidance. ArduPilot SITL + ROS + Gazebo.

features: Ray-Ground Intersection (RGI) geo-localization from monocular camera
Web-based operator control panel (radar, map, ownership)

vision.camera: ROS topic per drone port, 1280x720, HFOV=1.2rad (~69°), 30fps

swarm.coordinator: 1410 lines — target assignment, Hungarian matching, ownership management
swarm.fusion_engine: 648 lines — two-layer EKF: duplicate merge + cross-drone fusion, dynamic merge threshold (base=8m + sigma*2), Mahalanobis gating (3-sigma), covariance-weighted position fusion, coast mode with velocity prediction
swarm.protocol: 7-step attack handshake (ASSIGN→LOCK→APPROVE→CONFIRM→ECHO→VALIDATE→ATTACK), immutable state protection, backoff spam throttle
swarm.battlespace: Web UI state provider, radar view, target ownership, drone state aggregation, display position smoothing (alpha=0.35)
swarm.target: TrackedTarget with 50+ attributes: covariance matrix, drone-local ID mapping, group membership, ownership state (FREE/OWNED/RESERVED/HANDOFF), coast mode, observation quality scores
swarm.ownership: Sticky assignment with handoff policy (30 consecutive frames, 1.5x quality ratio, 10s cooldown)

mission.attack_fsm: 6 states: IDLE→ECHO→WAIT_CONFIRM→CENTERING→DIVING→IMPACT. Mid-attack guard prevents target swap. Zombie lock failsafe. Phase timeouts: echo=5s, center=10s, global=30s
mission.ibvs_guidance: Image-Based Visual Servoing for GPS-independent terminal attack. 3 phases: STARTUP (Vx=1.5m/s, gentle 5° pitch) → APPROACH (ramp to 8m/s, 10° pitch, ease-in-out curve) → TERMINAL (max speed, 15° pitch). Low-pass filters on yaw/vz/vx. Ghost mode (0.5s coast on target loss). Lateral body-frame correction. Pitch compensation for fixed camera mount.
mission.detection_processor: RGI (Ray-Ground Intersection) geo-localization from monocular camera + drone attitude. Covariance-aware: cross-range and radial uncertainty scales with depression angle. Edge compensation for FOV distortion.
mission.navigation: PID waypoint tracking (Kp=0.9, Ki=0.02, Kd=0.12). GPS median filter (window=7). Stuck detection (0.12m threshold, 8s timeout). Fine approach deceleration (7m threshold, 0.35 scale).

lane_detection.method: Color channel arithmetic (R*0.5 + G*0.5 - B) → LUT threshold (32-48) → morphological open (11x11) → contour centroids → linear regression

swarm_software.name: OpenIPC FPV
swarm_software.description: Alternative open-source firmware for IP cameras repurposed as FPV air units. Runs on cheap IP camera SoCs (HiSilicon, Goke, SigmaStar, Ingenic, etc.) with wifibroadcast (WFB-NG) for low-latency video. Turns a $15 IP camera board into a digital FPV transmitter. Lower latency than OpenHD on RPi (80ms 1080p60 vs 100-150ms) because the IP camera SoC has a dedicated hardware encoder. MIT license.

unique_features: Runs on $8-15 IP camera boards (cheapest FPV air unit possible)

Hardware H.265 encoding on camera SoC (no separate encoder needed)

APFPV mode — simple WiFi AP mode for phone viewing

common_params.channel_161: 5805 MHz — clean channel, standard for FPV

smolrtsp.description: Lightweight RTSP 1.0 server for embedded. Zero-copy parsing. H.264 + H.265 RTP. TCP + UDP. Used by Majestic streamer.
smolrtsp.use_in_forge: Can replace GStreamer RTSP for edge AI deployments on Jetson/APB. Smaller footprint than full GStreamer pipeline for video-only streaming.

ipctool.description: Identifies IP camera hardware — SoC, sensor, flash, network chip. Single static binary (musl). Run on any camera to discover what's inside.
ipctool.use_in_forge: Useful for identifying unknown camera modules on drone payloads. Drop ipctool binary onto any Linux camera board to get SoC/sensor/flash info.

divinus.description: Open-source multi-platform IP camera streamer. HAL architecture supports 20+ SoC families. RTSP + RTMP + UDP + fMP4 + MJPEG + JPEG snapshot. Night mode (auto IR cut/LED). OSD overlay. Audio (MP3 encode). ONVIF discovery.

modules.server.c: 1499 lines — HTTP API server with endpoints: /api/jpeg (snapshot), /api/mjpeg (stream), /api/mp4 (recording), /api/audio, /api/night (IR mode), /api/osd (overlay), /api/status, /api/cmd, /api/record, /api/time. Plus ONVIF discovery.
modules.media.c: 950 lines — encoder pipeline: video capture → HAL encode → RTSP + RTMP + UDP + MP4 + HTTP. Audio: PCM → MP3 (libshine) → RTSP + RTMP + MP4.
modules.stream.c: 456 lines — UDP/RTP streaming with multicast support, client management, RTP header construction
modules.rtsp/: 3592 lines — full RTSP 1.0 server: session management, RTP packetization (H.264/H.265), thread pool
modules.night.c: 155 lines — auto day/night switching via GPIO: IR cut filter + IR LED + grayscale mode
modules.jpeg.c: 143 lines — JPEG snapshot with per-platform HAL abstraction
modules.region.c: 555 lines — OSD overlay regions (text, bitmap, PNG)
modules.onvif.c: 397 lines — ONVIF device discovery and media profile responses

http_api_endpoints./api/night: Night mode control (IR cut, IR LED, grayscale)
http_api_endpoints./api/status: System status (uptime, encoder state, stream stats)

use_in_forge: HAL pattern: portable SoC abstraction for multi-platform camera code — same API, different hardware. Relevant for AI/CV guide when supporting multiple companion computers.
HTTP API: /api/jpeg endpoint is a clean pattern for grabbing camera frames for AI inference without GStreamer. Hit the endpoint, get a JPEG, run YOLO.
Night mode: GPIO-based IR cut/LED switching pattern is directly applicable to thermal camera integration on drones.
RTSP server: lighter than GStreamer for embedded video streaming. The rtsp/ directory is a self-contained 3592-line RTSP implementation.
UDP/RTP streaming with multicast: the stream.c pattern (456 lines) is a clean reference for implementing WFB-NG style video broadcast.

payload_droppers.name: DEVCOM Audible Dropper — M67 Grenade Release System
payload_droppers.description: 3D-printed munition dropper developed by the US Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM). Mounts under a Skydio X10D sUAS. Remotely pulls the M67 grenade pin mid-flight via electronic trigger, enabling precise delivery against static and moving targets. First live M67 grenade drop by conventional US Army forces conducted June 25, 2025 at Grafenwoehr Training Area, Germany (7ATC, 278th ACR, 173rd Airborne). Follow-on September 2025 trial dropped 117 live M67 grenades. Gen 2 version in development addressing release reliability and stabilization. Field-printable — soldiers can 3D print in theater using commercial CAD software and standard Army additive manufacturing kits. Part of Project Shiv experimentation lineage. Inspired by Ukraine FPV grenade-drop tactics.

compliance.note: US Army government-developed. Not commercially available. 3D-printable in field. No procurement pathway — DEVCOM internal.

programs: US Army Europe and Africa multi-domain modernization

payload_droppers.name: Widowmaker 3D-Printed Grenade Dropper
payload_droppers.description: Soldier-developed 3D-printed pylon-mounted munition dropper designed and fabricated entirely in theater by soldiers from the Multi Purpose Company, 1-502nd Infantry, 2nd Mobile BCT, 101st Airborne Division. Tested on a PDW C100 drone during Combined Resolve 26-1 at Grafenwoehr, October 9, 2025. Electronically triggered release mechanism. Demonstrated 4 grenades per sortie with accuracy from standoff ranges exceeding 100 meters. Compatible with M67 fragmentation grenades, M18 smoke grenades, and training munitions. Produced using commercial CAD software and standard Army additive manufacturing kits — no formal engineering background required. Represents squad-level organic air-delivered munitions capability. Pylon mounts under drone fuselage without compromising stability.
payload_droppers.munition_compatibility: M67 fragmentation grenade, M18 smoke grenade, training munitions

compliance.note: Soldier-designed and fabricated in theater. Not commercially available. Open design — printable with standard Army AM kits.

payload_droppers.name: UAV Systems International Payload Release Mechanism
payload_droppers.description: Commercial servo-actuated payload release/drop mechanism for multi-rotor UAS. Supports payloads up to 5kg (11lb). Optimized for 3.5kg payloads. Triggered via remote controller button. Includes mounting hardware, setup, and controller configuration. Delivered in wooden box. NDAA 848 and TAA compliant. US-manufactured electronics (flight controllers and onboard electronics made in California). Used in NATO ammo resupply trial with Aurelia X6 Pro fleet — soldiers activated drop via helmet-mounted button to GPS coordinates. Also used for medical supply delivery in Sierra Leone and photogrammetry surveys in Canada. Available for Tarot X6, Tarot T-18, Tarot 650, and universal configurations.
payload_droppers.compatible_platform: Tarot X6, Tarot T-18, Tarot 650, Aurelia X6 Pro, universal mounting

compliance.note: NDAA 848 and TAA compliant. US electronics (California). Commercially available. NATO trial use documented.

programs: NATO ammo resupply trial (Aurelia X6 Pro fleet)
