c2_datalinks.name: uAvionix microLink — Aviation-Grade BVLOS C2 Radio
c2_datalinks.description: FCC and IC approved aviation-grade BVLOS C2 datalink radio specifically designed for long-range mission-critical UAS operations. Provides CNPC (Control and Non-Payload Communication) with 2x2 MIMO diversity. Integrates with SkyLine cloud-managed C2 service for multi-aircraft fleet management, path/link diversity, and seamless roaming between ground stations. TSO-C213a compliant. ISM 902-928 MHz band.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: uAvionix Corporation, Bigfork MT. US avionics company. NDAA compliant.

c2_datalinks.name: uAvionix muLTElink-5060 — Multi-Datalink ARS with LTE & C-Band
c2_datalinks.description: Multi-datalink Airborne Radio System (ARS) and Link Executive Manager providing simultaneous CNPC C2 over C-Band (5030-5091 MHz aviation protected spectrum), cellular LTE, and LEO satellite (Starlink compatible). Automatic link switching with 1-second evaluation cadence and double-hysteresis. Demonstrated in UK BVLOS trials with seamless handover across C-Band, cellular, and satcom in challenging coastal environments.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: uAvionix Corporation, Bigfork MT. US avionics company. NDAA compliant.

c2_datalinks.name: Silvus StreamCaster SC4200EP — Tactical MANET C2 Datalink
c2_datalinks.description: 2x2 MIMO tactical MANET radio delivering best-in-class C2, video, and telemetry in a single transceiver for unmanned systems. Proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides self-healing, self-forming mesh networking with no operator involvement. Battle-proven across defense, law enforcement, and public safety deployments. Handles simultaneous video, C2, and health/telemetry data. NDAA and DoD cybersecurity compliant; approved for Blue UAS platforms.
c2_datalinks.form_factor: ruggedized enclosure or OEM PCB stack
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: Silvus Technologies, Los Angeles CA. US MANET radio manufacturer. NDAA compliant. Multiple DoD contracts.

c2_datalinks.name: Silvus StreamCaster Lite SL5200 — Ultra-Low SWaP MANET for Group 1 UAS
c2_datalinks.description: Ultra-low SWaP OEM module delivering Group 2 UAV-level MANET radio performance in a form factor designed for Group 1 platforms. Powered by Silvus' proprietary MN-MIMO waveform for self-forming, self-healing mesh networking. Provides single-radio solution for simultaneous video, C2, and telemetry. Enables convoy, relay, and swarm capability between multiple manned and unmanned systems.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: Silvus Technologies, Los Angeles CA. US MANET radio manufacturer. NDAA compliant. Multiple DoD contracts.

c2_datalinks.name: CubePilot Herelink V1.1 — HD Video + C2 Datalink System
c2_datalinks.description: Integrated HD video transmission, data link, and ground control station system for drones. 2.4 GHz ISM band with up to 20 km range (FCC) / 12 km (CE). Dual HDMI inputs supporting 720p/1080p at 30/60fps with minimum 110ms latency. Android-based 5.46-inch 1080P touchscreen controller runs QGroundControl and MissionPlanner natively. Pinecone S1 processor (8-core). Widely adopted in ArduPilot/PX4 ecosystem.

c2_datalinks.name: Ultra I&C ADSI — Multi-Domain C2 Gateway
c2_datalinks.description: Multi-domain C2 gateway system communicating over dozens of tactical datalinks from Link 16 and NATO Link 1 to distributed systems datalinks. First CBC2 gateway to receive continuous Authority to Operate (cATO) from DoD, enabling autonomous software updates via DevSecOps pipeline. Supports Cursor on Target (CoT), JREAP-C translation, and rapid reconfiguration of tactical datalink interfaces. Cloud-enabled containerized architecture. Demonstrated NATO interoperability at CWIX 2024 in Poland.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: Ultra Electronics, UK. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Part of Cobham Advanced Electronic Systems.

c2_datalinks.name: Performance Drone Works Blackwave — Next-Gen UAS Radio System
c2_datalinks.description: Next-generation radio system designed for critical UAS communications in contested and congested electromagnetic environments. Awarded a USSOCOM contract for development. Designed to provide resilient C2 links for tactical sUAS operations where standard datalinks are vulnerable to EW threats. AES-256 encrypted. Integrates with PDW's C100 Blue UAS platform.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: Performance Drone Works, Sarasota FL. US UAS C2 manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

c2_datalinks.name: Kutta Technologies KGS — Tactical UAS C2 Software Suite
c2_datalinks.description: Mission-critical hardware and software solutions for tactical drone C2. Selected by leading clients including the US Department of Defense. Provides interoperability between multiple UAS types and ground stations through standardized data interfaces. Supports STANAG 4586 compliant control of unmanned systems.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: Kutta Technologies, Phoenix AZ. US DoD C2 software company. NDAA compliant.

c2_datalinks.name: DTC BluSDR-90-UL — Ultra-Light Long-Range SDR for UAS
c2_datalinks.description: Ultra-light software-defined radio offering long-range mission-critical connectivity with battlefield-proven MeshUltra MANET networking. COFDM IP Mesh waveforms support adaptive modulation up to 64QAM with data rates to 87 Mbps. Frequency coverage 320 MHz to 6 GHz with selectable channel bandwidths from 1.25 to 20 MHz. Integrated with Nordic-Wing Astero ISR UAV with high-end encryption and anti-jamming. US Army, DOJ, DHS, and DOD contracts. 250,000+ radios built.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: DTC (Codan Communications), Adelaide, Australia. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Major MANET supplier to Five Eyes nations.

c2_datalinks.name: DTC SOL8SDR-M BluCore — Miniature SDR for Nano/sUAS
c2_datalinks.description: Miniature software-defined radio transceiver at just 54x50x11mm and 60g, designed for sub-250g nano UAS and swarming drones. Supports MeshUltra MANET with 80+ nodes on same frequency. Self-healing, self-forming mesh enables swarm and mother/daughter UAS architectures. RF LOS ranges up to 250 km with optimized antenna and amplifier. Supports all DTC COFDM IP Mesh and unidirectional waveforms.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: DTC (Codan Communications), Adelaide, Australia. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Major MANET supplier to Five Eyes nations.

c2_datalinks.name: L3Harris AMORPHOUS — Decentralized Swarm C2 Software
c2_datalinks.description: Software suite designed to control thousands of drones simultaneously through a decentralized system, eliminating reliance on a single mothership drone. Represents a significant leap in swarm technology where multiple drones operate in unison, autonomously adapting to battlefield conditions. Part of the broader L3Harris autonomous systems portfolio.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: L3Harris Technologies. US defense prime. NDAA compliant.

c2_datalinks.name: XTEND XOS — Tactical Drone Operating System for C2 Integration
c2_datalinks.description: Tactical drone operating system enabling intuitive control of small tactical drones in complex operational environments. Integrated into Lockheed Martin Skunk Works MDCX multi-domain C2 platform. Enables single operator to manage transitions between large carrier drone and small tactical drone within same mission context. Reduces cognitive burden and minimizes real-time points of failure. Demonstrated carrier-deployed drone operations with seamless C2 handoff.
c2_datalinks.datalink_type: Tactical drone OS / C2 integration layer
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: XTEND, Tel Aviv, Israel. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. XOS tactical drone OS.

c2_datalinks.name: Shield AI Hivemind — AI Pilot for Autonomous UAS C2
c2_datalinks.description: AI-powered autonomous pilot technology for unmanned systems providing GPS-denied, comms-denied autonomous flight capability. Being integrated onto Navy BQM-177A subsonic aerial targets under OTA agreement for autonomous flight foundation. Enables autonomous teaming and cooperative engagement without continuous C2 link. Core technology for CCA (Collaborative Combat Aircraft) programs.
c2_datalinks.ndaa_note: Shield AI, San Diego CA. US AI autonomy company. NDAA compliant. DoD prime contractor.

ew_systems.name: DroneShield DroneGun Tactical — Handheld RF Jammer
ew_systems.description: Highly effective handheld C-UAS countermeasure with directional antennas in a rifle-style design. Jams wide range of ISM bands and GNSS satellite navigation frequencies. Forces target drones to land vertically, return to operator, or return to starting point. Non-kinetic — does not damage UAS, preserving forensic evidence. NATO Stock Number assigned. 2+ hours battery life per charge. IP54 rated.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: DroneShield Ltd, Sydney/Washington DC. Allied-nation, US office, DoD supplier. NDAA compliant. Listed on Nasdaq (DRO).

ew_systems.name: DroneShield DroneGun Mk4 — Lightweight Handheld Jammer
ew_systems.description: Advanced lightweight counter-drone jammer with wider environmental suitability than previous models. Compact pistol-grip design with trigger assembly, safety selector switch, and quick-release battery. LED indicators show active bands and disruption status (can be disabled for covert ops). Disrupts FPV video streaming back to remote controller. MIL-STD 1913 rails for scope mounting. No software updates required — ready out of box.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: DroneShield Ltd, Sydney/Washington DC. Allied-nation, US office, DoD supplier. NDAA compliant. Listed on Nasdaq (DRO).

ew_systems.name: Flex Force / DZYNE Dronebuster — DoD-Authorized Handheld C-UAS
ew_systems.description: Compact, lightweight, cost-effective C-UAS electronic attack system — the only handheld electronic attack system authorized by the US Department of Defense. Converts between integrated fixed-site jammer and man-portable jammer for dismounted troops, security teams, and first responders. Multiple configurations available. ITAR controlled. Dronebuster PNT variant adds positioning/navigation/timing defeat capability.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: DZYNE Technologies, Irvine CA. US manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

ew_systems.name: D-Fend Solutions EnforceAir2 — RF Cyber Takeover C-UAS System
ew_systems.description: High-performance counter-drone system using RF cyber takeover technology — not jamming. Detects, locates, identifies rogue drones, then takes control via protocol manipulation and lands them safely in predefined zones. Non-jamming, non-kinetic, no line-of-sight required. Preserves communications and operational continuity. Supports commercial and proprietary/DIY radio protocols. Deployable as tactical, vehicular, stationary, backpack, and maritime configurations. Trusted by US government agencies.
ew_systems.defeat_method: RF protocol cyber takeover — controlled landing
ew_systems.ndaa_note: D-Fend Solutions, Ra'anana, Israel. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

ew_systems.name: NT Service EDM4S SkyWiper — Portable Anti-Drone EW Device
ew_systems.description: Portable electronic warfare anti-drone device that disrupts small and medium UAVs by jamming communication and satellite navigation systems. Single-operator pointed weapon with 3-5 km effective range. Combat proven in Ukraine — first deployed against Russian separatist drones in Donbas in 2021, continued use against Russian military drones including Eleron-3. Also produced under 'Skybeam' brand in partnership with Israeli company Skylock. Unit cost approximately $15,000 for UA variant.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: NT Service, Ukraine. EW/C-UAS developer. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

ew_systems.name: DroneShield DroneSentry — Integrated Detect & Defeat System
ew_systems.description: Fixed-site integrated C-UAS system combining radar, RF direction finding, EO/IR sensors for detection with RF barrage jamming, command link control, and GPS/GNSS jamming for defeat. Provides 360-degree automated protection zone. Multiple sensor fusion for low false-alarm rates. Designed for critical infrastructure, military bases, and event protection.
ew_systems.defeat_method: RF barrage jamming + command link control + GNSS jamming
ew_systems.ndaa_note: DroneShield Ltd, Sydney/Washington DC. Allied-nation, US office, DoD supplier. NDAA compliant. Listed on Nasdaq (DRO).

ew_systems.name: Aselsan KORAL — Land-Based Radar EW System
ew_systems.description: Land-based radar electronic warfare system providing both electronic support (ESM/ELINT) and electronic attack capabilities. Composed of two trucks — one for electronic support and one for electronic attack. Jams and deceives conventional and complex hostile radar types. Analyzes multiple target signals across wide frequency range. Credited as the 'invisible power' behind Turkey's successful drone operations in Syria, Libya, and Azerbaijan since 2016. Suppresses enemy air defense radar to enable UAS operations.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: Aselsan, Ankara, Turkey. Turkish state defense company. Turkey is NATO member but has complex US relationship (F-35 exclusion over S-400 purchase). NDAA status uncertain — verify per contract. Do not assume NDAA compliant without contracting officer review.

ew_systems.name: infiniDome GPSdome — GNSS Anti-Jam Protection Module
ew_systems.description: Compact GNSS anti-jamming protection module using adaptive nulling algorithms to mitigate jamming threats in real-time. Provides high GNSS integrity with minimal weight and power consumption, optimized for UAV platforms. Multi-constellation (GPS, Galileo, BeiDou, GLONASS) and multi-band (L1/L2/L5) support. Sensor fusion with INS for continued navigation during signal degradation. Withstands J/S ratios of 40+ dB.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: infiniDome, Caesarea, Israel. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. GNSS anti-jam protection.

ew_systems.name: DroneShield RfPatrol Mk2 — Wearable RF Drone Detector
ew_systems.description: Passive wearable RF drone detection sensor with no intentional RF transmissions for quiet, safe operation. Omni-directional ISM band antenna provides situational awareness of drone threats. Part of the Immediate Response Kit (IRK) paired with DroneGun Mk4 for detect-and-defeat capability. Additional antenna ports available for capability expansion. Designed for dismounted troops and security teams.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: DroneShield Ltd, Sydney/Washington DC. Allied-nation, US office, DoD supplier. NDAA compliant. Listed on Nasdaq (DRO).

ew_systems.name: Raytheon NGJ-MB (Next-Generation Jammer Mid-Band)
ew_systems.description: Advanced airborne electronic attack system using agile AESA (Active Electronically Scanned Array) antenna technology with all-digital back end. Denies, disrupts, and degrades enemy communications, air defense systems, and radar. Digital and software-based design increases jamming capability with rapid beam steering and advanced modulation. Operates from increased ranges, attacks multiple targets simultaneously. Designed for EA-18G Growler aircraft. Passed Milestone C for production.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: Raytheon Technologies (RTX), Arlington VA. US defense prime (NYSE: RTX). NDAA compliant.

ew_systems.name: Krasukha-4 — Russian Mobile EW System
ew_systems.description: Russian mobile ground-based electronic warfare system capable of jamming airborne radar systems including AWACS and satellites. Mounted on BAZ-6910 chassis. Deployed extensively in Ukraine conflict for drone suppression, communications degradation, and GPS jamming. Part of Russia's doctrine of using EW to find and isolate positions before overwhelming with artillery fire. One of 14+ dedicated Russian military EW units.

ew_systems.name: Murmansk-BN — Russian Long-Range HF Jammer
ew_systems.description: Russian ground-based long-range jammer capable of suppressing high-frequency radio communications across a theoretical 300 km range — potentially limiting HF comms for most of a theater of operations. Represents the large-scale, theater-level EW capability that NATO has struggled to match. Part of Russia's deep EW doctrine integrating electronic warfare with kinetic fires.

ew_systems.name: Pole-21 — Russian Radio Suppression System
ew_systems.description: Advanced Russian radio suppression system designed specifically for counter-UAS operations. Detects and neutralizes UAS by intercepting communications and suppressing control channels. Deployed alongside Silok-01 in Russian C-UAS exercises. Part of the evolving Russian EW doctrine that prioritizes drone suppression at the tactical level.

ew_systems.name: GIDS Spider-AD — Counter-UAV Jammer System
ew_systems.description: Counter-UAV electronic warfare system capable of jamming drone communication and satellite navigation at ranges beyond 10 km. Available in both vehicle-mounted and man-portable tripod variants. Unveiled at a 2024 defense exhibition. Represents the growing accessibility of EW/C-UAS technology to developing nations as low-cost drone threats proliferate.
ew_systems.ndaa_note: GIDS — Global Industrial and Defence Solutions, Pakistan. Pakistan is NOT an allied nation for NDAA purposes. Non-NDAA compliant.

navigation_pnt.name: SBG Systems Pulse-40 — Tactical Grade MEMS IMU
navigation_pnt.description: Tactical grade IMU with 0.08°/√h noise gyro and 6µg accelerometers. Individually calibrated with advanced MEMS technology. 12-gram weight at 0.3W power. ITAR-free. Designed for UAV navigation in GNSS-denied environments with sophisticated multi-sensor fusion algorithms including adaptive notch filtering and RAIM for jamming/spoofing mitigation. Combat-proven motion and navigation solutions.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: SBG Systems, Rueil-Malmaison, France. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

navigation_pnt.name: Inertial Labs VINS — Vision-Aided Inertial Navigation System
navigation_pnt.description: Fully integrated Vision-Aided INS + AHRS + Air Data Computer (ADC) providing navigation in both GPS-enabled and GPS-denied environments. MIL-STD-810 and MIL-STD-461 compliant. Uses machine vision algorithms combined with 25+ years of INS development. Determines position, velocity, and absolute orientation (heading, pitch, roll) for fixed-wing, VTOL, and multirotor UAVs. Centimeter-level accuracy with VIO in GPS-denied conditions.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Inertial Labs Inc., Paeonian Springs VA. US GNSS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

navigation_pnt.name: Inertial Labs M-AJ-QUATRO — Multi-Element Anti-Jam Antenna
navigation_pnt.description: Multi-element anti-jamming advanced antenna system designed for Assured PNT across GNSS-jammed, spoofed, and denied environments. CRPA (Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna) architecture with multiple nulling elements to reject interference from multiple simultaneous jammers. Highlighted as a 2025 breakthrough technology for unmanned systems. Pairs with Inertial Labs INS family for resilient navigation.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Inertial Labs Inc., Paeonian Springs VA. US GNSS/INS manufacturer. NDAA compliant. DoD supplier.

navigation_pnt.name: Advanced Navigation Boreas D90 — FOG INS
navigation_pnt.description: High-performance fiber optic gyroscope (FOG) inertial navigation system with AI-powered sensor fusion. Achieved sub-0.1% distance accuracy during deep-mine field testing — proving reliable autonomy where GPS is completely unavailable. Revolutionary AI-powered fusion algorithm. Designed for defense, mining, and autonomous vehicle navigation in the most challenging GNSS-denied environments.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Advanced Navigation, Sydney, Australia. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

navigation_pnt.name: Honeywell HGuide o480 — Low-SWaP INS with Anti-Jam/Anti-Spoof
navigation_pnt.description: Low-SWaP inertial navigation system featuring integrated anti-jamming and anti-spoofing capabilities. Available with single- or dual-antenna GNSS for enhanced resilience. Designed for UAS and autonomous vehicle applications requiring assured PNT in contested environments. Honeywell's heritage in aerospace-grade navigation brought to compact form factor.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Honeywell International, Charlotte NC. Major US aerospace/defense (NASDAQ: HON). NDAA compliant.

navigation_pnt.name: Infleqtion Tiqker — Quantum Optical Atomic Clock
navigation_pnt.description: Quantum optical clock using infrared lasers tuned to rubidium electron transitions for ultra-precise timekeeping — loses one second every 2 million years. Passed tests on UK flight trials, US Army ground vehicles in New Mexico, and drone submarines. Provides the timing component of PNT when GPS timing is denied. Rack-mountable form factor. Part of emerging quantum PNT ecosystem alongside atom-interferometry inertial sensors.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Infleqtion (formerly ColdQuanta), Boulder CO. US quantum sensing. NDAA compliant. DARPA/DoD funded.

navigation_pnt.name: Q-CTRL Ironstone Opal — Quantum Magnetic Navigation
navigation_pnt.description: Quantum-enhanced magnetic navigation system using machine learning to track aircraft location via Earth's magnetic field anomalies. Demonstrated 94x more accurate tracking than strategic-grade conventional INS in Cessna flight trials. Two DARPA contracts awarded. Being tested with Northrop Grumman, Lockheed Martin, and Airbus. Provides GPS-independent position fixing by matching measured magnetic signatures against pre-mapped databases.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Q-CTRL, Sydney, Australia. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Quantum sensing/navigation.

navigation_pnt.name: ModalAI VOXL 2 VIO — Visual Inertial Odometry Navigation
navigation_pnt.description: GPS-denied navigation via Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) running on the VOXL 2 companion computer. Fuses camera image data with IMU data to estimate position and orientation in 3D space. Works both indoors and outdoors. Supports SLAM, VOA (Visual Obstacle Avoidance), ROS 2, and Docker. 7 concurrent camera inputs. Blue UAS Framework certified. Only 16g. Assembled in USA.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: ModalAI Inc., San Diego CA. US-made VOXL 2 autopilot. Blue UAS Framework listed. NDAA compliant.

navigation_pnt.name: Infleqtion Quantum Inertial Sensor — Atom Interferometry IMU
navigation_pnt.description: Quantum inertial sensor using atom interferometry — splitting rubidium atoms with precise laser pulses to measure acceleration and rotation with extreme precision. New continuous-beam architecture (tested October 2025) eliminates dead times of pulsed systems for true continuous navigation. Trialed on customized aircraft at British military testing site. Part of DARPA-funded quantum PNT ecosystem alongside Tiqker atomic clock.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Infleqtion (formerly ColdQuanta), Boulder CO. US quantum sensing. NDAA compliant. DARPA/DoD funded.

navigation_pnt.name: Advanced Navigation Certus Evo — MEMS INS/GNSS
navigation_pnt.description: High-precision MEMS-based INS/GNSS with AI-powered sensor fusion delivering centimeter-level accuracy. Features RTK-enabled positioning with Auto-Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter for performance in challenging GNSS environments. Tightly coupled GNSS/INS architecture maintains navigation during partial signal loss. Multi-constellation, multi-frequency GNSS support. Ideal for drone survey, mapping, and precision agriculture.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Advanced Navigation, Sydney, Australia. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

navigation_pnt.name: Teledyne Compact Navigator — DVL + INS for Maritime/Subsea UAS
navigation_pnt.description: All-in-one Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) plus INS system optimized for AUVs and ROVs. Provides reliable heading, depth, and stabilization in dynamic sea conditions where GPS is unavailable. Highlighted as a 2025 breakthrough for underwater autonomous navigation. Compact form factor integrates multiple sensors that traditionally required separate units.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Teledyne Marine, part of Teledyne Technologies (NYSE: TDY). US company. NDAA compliant.

navigation_pnt.name: Anello Maritime INS — High-Grade Photonic INS
navigation_pnt.description: High-grade inertial navigation system using silicon photonic optical gyroscope technology for maritime and autonomous vehicle applications. Provides tactical-to-navigation grade accuracy with no moving parts and solid-state construction. Offers significant cost and size advantages over traditional fiber optic and ring laser gyro systems while approaching their accuracy.
navigation_pnt.ndaa_note: Anello Photonics, Santa Clara CA. US photonic IMU. NDAA compliant. DARPA-funded.

ai_accelerators.name: Hailo-8 M.2 AI Accelerator Module
ai_accelerators.description: Purpose-built edge AI inference accelerator delivering 26 TOPS in an M.2 form factor at just 2.5W. Dataflow architecture eliminates memory bottleneck — data flows through processing stages continuously without returning to external memory. 100% utilization rates with linear performance stacking (up to 4x = 104 TOPS). Supports TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX. Widely adopted for drone vision systems, object detection, pose estimation, and facial recognition.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Hailo Technologies, Tel Aviv, Israel. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Hailo-10H — Edge AI Accelerator with GenAI Support
ai_accelerators.description: Second-generation AI accelerator delivering 40 TOPS with generative AI capabilities — first to run LLMs, VLMs, and other generative models entirely on-device without cloud. M.2 Key M form factor with on-module 4/8GB LPDDR4. Sub-1-second first-token latency, 10+ tokens/sec on 2B parameter models. YOLOv11m on real-time 4K video at 2.5W typical. AEC-Q100 Grade 2 automotive qualified. Supports Raspberry Pi ecosystem.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Hailo Technologies, Tel Aviv, Israel. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Ambarella CV5 — AI Vision SoC for Drones
ai_accelerators.description: Edge AI vision SoC delivering 20+ TOPS optimized for computer vision in drones and cameras. Combines CVflow AI accelerator with advanced ISP for simultaneous AI processing and high-quality imaging. Supports 8K video encoding, multi-camera inputs, CNN and transformer networks. Powers next-gen drone autonomy from L1 to L4 levels. Heritage in aerial imaging (DJI and consumer action cameras). Deployed in Antigravity A1 drone.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Ambarella Inc., Santa Clara CA. US semiconductor company (NASDAQ: AMBA). NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Ambarella CV7 — Multi-Stream AI Vision SoC
ai_accelerators.description: Latest generation edge AI vision SoC for processing multiple high-quality camera streams simultaneously via CNNs or transformer networks. Features latest-gen CVflow AI accelerator, in-house ISP with AI-driven features, quad ARM Cortex-A73 cores, hardware video codecs, and 64-bit DRAM interface. Targets 8K consumer products, multi-camera security, robotics, drones, and automotive ADAS.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Ambarella Inc., Santa Clara CA. US semiconductor company (NASDAQ: AMBA). NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Google Coral USB Accelerator — Edge TPU
ai_accelerators.description: USB-form-factor AI accelerator using Google's Edge TPU providing 4 TOPS for on-device ML inference. Simplest integration path for adding AI capabilities to existing drone companion computers. Supports TensorFlow Lite models compiled via Edge TPU Compiler. Popular for prototyping and lightweight inference tasks like object classification, detection, and tracking on sUAS.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Google LLC, Mountain View CA. US company. Coral Edge TPU. NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Kneron KL720 — Edge AI SoC
ai_accelerators.description: Edge AI processor capable of executing transformer models (GPT-class architectures) in a compact, low-power package. Designed for drones, robotics, and smart cameras. Features hardware NPU with dedicated CNN and RNN/transformer acceleration. Supports multiple AI frameworks. Approximately 1/10th the performance of Hailo-10 but at significantly lower cost and power, suitable for simpler inference tasks.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Kneron Inc., San Diego CA. US-incorporated AI chip company (Taiwan-founded). NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: DeepX DX-M1 — 25 TOPS Edge AI Accelerator
ai_accelerators.description: 25 TOPS edge AI accelerator in a 5W power envelope designed for drones, robots, and camera systems. Proprietary quantization techniques enable INT8-quantized networks with accuracy comparable to FP32 originals — in some cases actually improving accuracy by reducing overfitting. Sits alongside standalone host CPU as co-processor. Available as module and PCIe card form factors.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: DeepX Inc., Seoul, South Korea. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Edge AI semiconductor company.

ai_accelerators.name: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano — Edge AI Module for Autonomous Drones
ai_accelerators.description: Compact AI compute module delivering up to 40 TOPS with NVIDIA Ampere GPU architecture. Supports CUDA, TensorRT, and the full NVIDIA JetPack SDK including ROS 2. Widely used for drone autonomy, SLAM, VIO, object detection, and path planning. ARK Electronics offers NDAA-compliant 'Just a Jetson' carrier board for defense drone applications. 7-15W configurable power envelope.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: NVIDIA Corporation, Santa Clara CA. US company (NASDAQ: NVDA). Fab: TSMC Taiwan. NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Qualcomm Robotics RB5 — 5G + AI Platform for Drones
ai_accelerators.description: Integrated 5G connectivity with edge AI processing delivering approximately 15 TOPS through Qualcomm AI Engine. Targets autonomous robots and drones requiring both high-bandwidth connectivity and on-device AI. Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.1, and 5G mmWave/sub-6. Supports up to 7 concurrent cameras. Heterogeneous compute (CPU + GPU + DSP + NPU). Runs Linux and ROS 2.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Qualcomm Technologies, San Diego CA. US semiconductor (NASDAQ: QCOM). NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Intel Movidius Myriad X VPU (Neural Compute Stick 2)
ai_accelerators.description: Vision Processing Unit delivering 4 TOPS in a compact USB form factor via Neural Compute Stick 2. Enables adding AI inference to existing systems without hardware modifications. Supported by Intel OpenVINO toolkit for model optimization across TensorFlow, PyTorch, and ONNX. Popular in academic and prototyping drone AI applications. Dedicated neural compute engine for CNN acceleration.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Intel Corporation, Santa Clara CA. US company. NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Kinara Ara-2 — GenAI Edge Accelerator
ai_accelerators.description: Second-generation edge AI accelerator targeting edge servers, laptops, and drones. Accelerates models up to 30 billion INT4 parameters in a 6W power envelope. Demonstrated Llama2-7B generating tens of tokens/sec and StableDiffusion 1.4 at 20 iterations in 10 seconds. VLIW architecture tuned for AI workloads with 5-8x performance over first gen. Optimized for both generative AI and vision workloads.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Kinara Inc., San Jose CA — acquired by NXP Semiconductors (Netherlands) 2024. US-origin, NXP is allied-nation. NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Axelera AI Metis — 214 TOPS Edge AI Chip
ai_accelerators.description: High-performance edge AI chip delivering 214 TOPS peak (mixed precision/INT8) at 14.7 TOPS/W efficiency. Quad-core digital in-memory compute architecture with RISC-V CPUs managing dataflow. Typical power consumption 10W. Designed for edge servers and high-end embedded systems requiring multi-stream video analytics, autonomous driving, and industrial automation.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Axelera AI, Eindhoven, Netherlands. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: Syntiant NDP250 — Ultra-Low Power Edge AI
ai_accelerators.description: Ultra-low power edge AI accelerator operating at microwatts for always-on applications and tens of milliwatts for full vision processing. 5x tensor throughput vs previous generation. Designed for always-on computer vision, speech recognition, and sensor data processing on battery-powered drones and wearables. Enables persistent AI monitoring without draining flight batteries.
ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: Syntiant Corp., Irvine CA. US ultra-low-power neural decision processor. NDAA compliant.

ai_accelerators.name: NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX TAA (16GB)
ai_accelerators.description: TAA-compliant (USA Country of Origin) Jetson Orin NX 16GB compute module with 1024-core Ampere GPU and 8-core ARM 64-bit CPU. Designed for AI inference on unmanned systems. Compatible with EchoMAV EchoPilot AI and other 260-pin Jetson NX carrier boards. Supports full NVIDIA JetPack SDK including DeepStream, Isaac, Triton, Riva. Part: 900-13767-0000-0A1 / 900-13767-0000-0A0.

compliance.note: TAA compliant (USA COO). Suitable for Blue UAS when paired with EchoPilot AI.

ai_accelerators.ndaa_note: NVIDIA Corporation, Santa Clara CA. US company (NASDAQ: NVDA). Fab: TSMC Taiwan. NDAA compliant.

ground_control_stations.name: Inspired Flight GS-ONE — NDAA-Compliant Handheld GCS
ground_control_stations.description: Purpose-built NDAA-compliant Ground Control Station with 7-inch 2000-nit sunlight-readable touchscreen. Qualcomm QCS6490 processor with 8GB RAM running Android 14. Hot-swappable batteries for all-day operations. Up to 6 miles range. Runs QGroundControl, MissionPlanner, UgCS, and Inspired Ground Control. Compatible with IF800 Tomcat and IF1200A platforms. Designed for professionals in demanding field environments.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: Inspired Flight Technologies, San Luis Obispo CA. US drone/GCS manufacturer. NDAA compliant.

ground_control_stations.name: QGroundControl (QGC) — Open Source GCS Software
ground_control_stations.description: Cross-platform open-source Ground Control Station providing full flight control and mission planning for any MAVLink-enabled drone. Runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Supports PX4 and ArduPilot autopilots. Drag-and-drop mission planning, vehicle setup/configuration, real-time telemetry. Deployed in Vantis (North Dakota statewide BVLOS network) and numerous military/commercial programs.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: Open-source protocol (Linux Foundation). NDAA compliant — open source, no foreign entity control.

ground_control_stations.name: Mission Planner — ArduPilot Full-Featured GCS
ground_control_stations.description: Full-featured desktop GCS for ArduPilot-based vehicles. Windows primary with experimental Linux/macOS support. Advanced features include detailed vehicle configuration, log analysis, simulation, 3D visualization, DEM import, comprehensive parameter editor, and scripting support. The most feature-rich GCS for ArduPilot ecosystem. Preferred by DIY builders and developers who need deep access to autopilot configuration.

ground_control_stations.name: MotioNew M10 — Handheld All-in-One GCS
ground_control_stations.description: Portable all-in-one handheld GCS integrating computer, radio with joysticks, and datalink in a single device. 10.1-inch 1200-nit sunlight-readable touchscreen (1920x1200). Runs Linux or Windows with QGroundControl and MissionPlanner. Eliminates need for separate laptop, radio controller, and datalink. Supports multirotor, fixed-wing, VTOL, UGV, ROV, and USV control. 10-point capacitive touchscreen.

ground_control_stations.name: UgCS — Enterprise Mission Planning GCS
ground_control_stations.description: Universal enterprise-grade GCS with 3D interface supporting APM, Pixhawk, DJI, Mikrokopter, and more. Simultaneous control of multiple drones. Features include DEM import, ADS-B transponder/receiver support, Click & Go mode, joystick mode, image geotagging, and video recording. 3D view mode with binding to physical structures and built-in simulator for mission visualization.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: SPH Engineering, Riga, Latvia. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant. UgCS mission planning software.

ground_control_stations.name: Winmate Rugged GCS Platform — Industrial Tablet/Console
ground_control_stations.description: Rugged outdoor computing platform for GCS applications available as tablets, dual-screen briefcase consoles, or rack-mount industrial PCs. IP-rated housings, high-brightness sunlight-readable touchscreens, reinforced frames, extended temperature operation. Supports AI acceleration modules and GPUs for real-time object tracking, thermal analysis, and intelligent mission automation. Software-agnostic: runs QGroundControl, MissionPlanner, UgCS, and custom OEM integrations. Supports RF, 4G/5G, and optional satellite links.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: Winmate Inc., Taipei, Taiwan. Allied-nation NDAA compliant. Rugged tablet/GCS hardware.

ground_control_stations.name: General Atomics Advanced Cockpit GCS
ground_control_stations.description: Military-grade digital ground control stations for direct, real-time control of Predator/Gray Eagle-series aircraft. Can be located on any land base, in any aircraft, or on any ship worldwide. Multi-display operator consoles with full mission planning, sensor control, weapon employment, and data exploitation capabilities. Represents the high end of military GCS capability for Group 5 UAS operations.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, San Diego CA. US defense prime. NDAA compliant. Maker of Predator/Reaper.

ground_control_stations.name: MAVProxy — Command Line GCS for Developers
ground_control_stations.description: Lightweight, extensible command-line GCS written in Python for Linux, primarily used by code developers. Provides graphical modules for map and mission editing alongside CLI interface. Extensible via Python modules for custom automation and scripting. Low resource footprint makes it ideal for companion computer integration on drones running ArduPilot.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: ArduPilot open-source GCS. Linux Foundation project. NDAA compliant — open source, no foreign adversary control.

ground_control_stations.name: ARK Electronics Just a Jetson — NDAA-Compliant Carrier Board
ground_control_stations.description: NDAA-compliant carrier board for NVIDIA Jetson modules providing secure onboard AI compute for defense drone applications. Designed to bring Jetson Orin capabilities into Blue UAS and NDAA-compliant airframes. Supports PX4 and ArduPilot integration. Highlighted as a 2025 breakthrough in autonomous drone compute for defense.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: ARK Electronics, USA. Designed and manufactured USA. NDAA compliant.

ground_control_stations.name: UAV Navigation VECTOR — Autopilot + Flight Control System
ground_control_stations.description: Professional autopilot and flight control system with integrated Iridium SATCOM for BVLOS operations. Validated integration with ATMOSPHERE SATCOM terminal for reliable, low-latency satellite connectivity. Supports fixed-wing, VTOL, and multirotor platforms. Part of the growing European autonomous drone ecosystem. Strengthens BVLOS autonomy through satellite-based C2 link.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: UAV Navigation, Madrid, Spain. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant. Part of Grupo Oesía defense.

ground_control_stations.name: Veronte Autopilots — High-Reliability Avionics GCS Ecosystem
ground_control_stations.description: Series of high-reliability avionics systems for real-time adaptive control of unmanned vehicles (UAV, USV, UGV). Provides both autopilot hardware and ground control software ecosystem. Features redundant architecture, DO-254/DO-178C certification path, and support for complex mission profiles. Used in military and civilian applications across Europe and globally.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: Embention, Valencia, Spain. EU/NATO allied-nation NDAA compliant. Veronte avionics.

ground_control_stations.name: Auterion Mission Control — Enterprise Drone Fleet GCS
ground_control_stations.description: Enterprise-grade ground control and fleet management platform built on PX4 open-source autopilot. Cloud-connected for fleet-wide mission management, analytics, and over-the-air updates. Supports US Army SRR (Short Range Reconnaissance) program. NDAA-compliant. Provides standardized interface across multiple drone platforms for defense and commercial operators.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: Auterion Inc., San Francisco CA (Swiss-founded, US HQ). NDAA compliant. Enterprise PX4 platform.

ground_control_stations.name: VOTIX DroneOS — Autonomous Drone Operating System
ground_control_stations.description: Autonomous drone operating system providing DFR (Drone as First Responder) and AAM (Advanced Air Mobility) capabilities. Integrates uAvionix FlightLine ADS-B data for real-time Detect and Avoid situational awareness. Enables autonomous launch, mission execution, and landing without continuous human control. Designed for public safety, security, and infrastructure inspection deployments.
ground_control_stations.ndaa_note: VOTIX, USA. US drone OS/fleet management company. NDAA compliant.

ground_control_stations.name: Draganfly Surveyor
ground_control_stations.manufacturer_hq: Saskatoon, SK, Canada / Tampa, FL, USA
ground_control_stations.description: Flight planning and mission execution software for Draganfly platforms. Enables automated grid flight mode for mapping and surveying. Integrates with Commander2, Commander 3XL, Tango2, and Heavy Lift. Supports multi-axis stabilized data acquisition. Used in conjunction with MicaSense, FLIR, and LiDAR payloads. Also referenced as MAVLink-based flight planning compatible with Mission Planner and QGroundControl for advanced users.

military_firmware.name: MILELRS
military_firmware.description: Military fork of ExpressLRS 3.3.2. Adds multiband redundancy (900 MHz + 2.4 GHz simultaneous), encrypted per-transmitter binding keys, real-time EW spectrum scanning with direction-finding, automatic channel switching on interference detection, multi-RX support for redundant control paths, swarm ID, and extended failsafe timers. Pairs with MILBETA for OSD tactical display. Most widely deployed military control link in the Russo-Ukrainian War.
military_firmware.ndaa_note: Ukrainian open-source firmware community. Allied-nation compliant.

military_firmware.name: MILBETA
military_firmware.description: Military fork of Betaflight (4.3.3/4.5.1). Processes tactical data from MILELRS receivers and displays on pilot OSD. OSD camouflage, EW direction-finding overlay, VTX frequency unlock (3000-6999 MHz), extended failsafe timers (10x), LQ statistics across 12 bands, armed VTX switching.
military_firmware.ndaa_note: Ukrainian open-source firmware community. Allied-nation compliant.

military_firmware.name: BarvinokLRS
military_firmware.description: Independent Ukrainian control link firmware (not an ELRS fork). Distributed free to frontline military units. Operates on multiple frequencies with different RF parameters. Field-proven to maintain link under EW conditions where other systems fail. Defense Builder accelerator grant funded.
military_firmware.ndaa_note: Ukrainian FPV firmware project. Allied-nation compliant.

military_firmware.name: Barvinok-5 Video Module
military_firmware.description: Encrypted digital video replacing analog FPV. FHSS pseudo-random frequency hopping with very small packets. Retains one-directional transmission and low latency of analog. Prototype phase, beginning manufacturer integration.
military_firmware.ndaa_note: Ukrainian FPV firmware project. Allied-nation compliant.

military_firmware.name: 1001 DJI Military Firmware
military_firmware.description: Custom firmware for DJI Mavic drones. Removes flight limits, improves GPS spoofing resistance, enables high-capacity batteries. ~200,000 drones flashed. Distribution via closed terminal network. Infrastructure compromised by cyberattack July 2025.

military_firmware.name: CIAJeepDoors
military_firmware.description: Disables DJI Remote ID to prevent AeroScope operator tracking. Delivered via USB device (Olga). DJI newer models block this patch.
military_firmware.ndaa_note: Ukrainian volunteer firmware developers. Allied-nation compliant.

military_firmware.name: mLRS
military_firmware.description: Open-source LoRa RC + full MAVLink telemetry. 433/868/915/2400 MHz, 7-87 km range. Full diversity. MatekSys purpose-built hardware. ArduPilot native support. Not military-specific but BVLOS/contested-relevant.
military_firmware.ndaa_note: olliw42 — Oliver Wiesner, Germany. Open-source mLRS firmware. EU/NATO allied-nation. NDAA compliant.

military_firmware.name: DroneBridge ESP32
military_firmware.description: ESP32 serial-to-WiFi/ESP-NOW telemetry bridge. AES-256-GCM encryption. MAVLink/MSP/LTM. ~1 km ESP-NOW LR. Swarm via encrypted ESP-NOW broadcasts. $3-5 per board. Pure C (ESP-IDF).
military_firmware.ndaa_note: Wolfgang Kröpfl, Germany. DroneBridge ESP32 open-source. EU/NATO. NDAA compliant.

optical_flow.name: ARK Flow — Optical Flow + ToF Distance Sensor
optical_flow.description: Made in the USA, NDAA compliant DroneCAN optical flow and short-range distance sensor. Combines PAW3902 optical flow sensor, Broadcom AFBR-S50LV85D ToF LiDAR, and BMI088 IMU. CAN protocol. PX4 and ArduPilot support. Firmware updates over DroneCAN. Gold standard for NDAA-compliant GPS-denied navigation.
optical_flow.ndaa_note: Designed and manufactured USA. Full supply chain documentation available.

optical_flow.name: ARK Flow MR — Mid-Range Optical Flow + Distance Sensor
optical_flow.description: Drop-in upgrade to ARK Flow with extended 50m mid-range distance sensing. PAA3905 optical flow sensor (improved over PAW3902), Broadcom AFBR-S50LX85D 50m ToF sensor, InvenSense IIM-42653 IMU. Adds only 5g over base ARK Flow. Launched March 2025. Best NDAA-compliant option for outdoor and semi-outdoor GPS-denied operations.
optical_flow.ndaa_note: Designed and manufactured USA. March 2025 release.

optical_flow.name: CubePilot HereFlow — Optical Flow + LiDAR
optical_flow.description: Finger-sized 1.2g optical flow sensor with integrated LiDAR and 6D IMU. PMW3901 optical flow (80mm to infinity), short-range LiDAR altimetry, ICM20602 IMU. CAN protocol. NDAA 2024 compliant — all chips and components sourced and assembled in allied nations (Taiwan). Best lightweight option for small/micro platforms. Note: built-in LiDAR is very short range outdoors; pair with external longer-range LiDAR for outdoor use.
optical_flow.ndaa_note: Manufactured Taiwan. 2024 NDAA compliant — allied nations supply chain.

optical_flow.name: Holybro H-Flow — Optical Flow + Distance Sensor
optical_flow.description: Compact DroneCAN optical flow and distance sensor. PixArt PAA3905E1 optical flow, Broadcom AFBR-S50LV85D ToF distance sensor, InvenSense ICM-42688-P 6-axis IMU. Onboard IR LED for low-light. Compatible with PX4 and ArduPilot. Good component selection (same sensors as ARK Flow MR) but Holybro HQ is Shenzhen, China — supply chain not independently verified for NDAA compliance. Verify before federal procurement.
optical_flow.ndaa_note: Holybro HQ: Shenzhen, China. Supply chain not independently verified. Do not use for federal contracts without written NDAA compliance documentation from Holybro.

optical_flow.name: Centeye Vision Chip Suite — Neuromorphic Optical Flow
optical_flow.description: Washington DC-based pioneer — first company to fly an optical flow sensor on a drone (1990s). Produces proprietary neuromorphic vision chips designed ground-up for drone autonomy. Sensors from 1g. Up to 150° FOV. IR illumination for dark environments (850nm, up to 5m range). Stereo depth + optical flow combined. Not a commodity product — sold as integrated solution or OEM chipset for custom platforms. Contact for pricing. Best option for nano/micro platforms and DARPA-adjacent programs.
optical_flow.ndaa_note: Designed and built USA. OEM/custom integration only.

optical_flow.name: Matek 3901-L0X — Optical Flow + LiDAR (UART)
optical_flow.description: PMW3901 optical flow + VL53L0X LiDAR combined module. UART interface, MSP V2 protocol. iNAV and ArduPilot compatible. Very popular in hobbyist/FPV community for indoor position hold. NOT NDAA compliant — designed and manufactured in China (Mateksys, Shenzhen). Do not use for federal contracts or federally-funded programs. Listed for awareness — this is what most people use, but it cannot be used in NDAA contexts.
optical_flow.ndaa_note: China-made. Not NDAA compliant. Hobbyist use only.

optical_flow.name: DJI O3 / Downward Vision (Integrated) — DJI Platforms Only
optical_flow.description: DJI's integrated downward visual positioning system on Mavic/Mini/Inspire/Matrice series. Combines downward-facing stereo cameras with ultrasonic sensors for indoor hover and obstacle avoidance. Not a standalone purchasable sensor — integrated into DJI platforms only. Not NDAA compliant. Listed for reference as the consumer benchmark most users know.
optical_flow.ndaa_note: China-made, FCC Covered List. Not NDAA compliant. Not available as standalone component.

drone_models.name: Apex Freestyle 5"

Built around the proven TBS Source One V6 frame and Axisflying 2207.5 motors on 6S, this build delivers explosive power and predictable handling for flips, rolls, power loops, and proximity flying. HAKRC F722 stack keeps things simple with a single-board FC+ESC solution. Analog 5.8GHz video keeps weight down and latency minimal. ELRS 2.4GHz for rock-solid control link. The go-to build for pilots stepping up from beginner quads or building their first custom rig.

Lightweight analog video system and RadioMaster ELRS nano receiver keep the all-up weight under 300g dry. Built for competitive MultiGP and FAI racing.

The FlyFishRC Volador II VX5 frame is specifically engineered for DJI O4/Walksnail camera mounting. Axisflying Argus ECO stack pairs an F4 FC with a 60A ESC for reliable power delivery. Walksnail Avatar HD Pro camera feeds stunning 1080p video to your goggles. True diversity ELRS receiver ensures bulletproof link in urban and mountain environments. This is the build for YouTube-quality FPV footage.

H743 flight controller runs GPS Rescue for automatic return-to-home on signal loss. Flywoo GOKU GPS module provides fast satellite fix. drone_models.name: Atlas X 10" CineLifter

This platform is for commercial filmmakers and cinema FPV operators who need reliability and payload capacity above all else.

drone_models.name: Stealth Hawk 5" Premium
